```
NVIM v0.13.0-dev-1959+g61e71ccf8a
Build type: RelWithDebInfo

```

## Release notes

- [Changelog](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/commit/61e71ccf8aa17a2fb6fe5caa115daf21a0b3e9fa) (fixes + features)
- [News](./runtime/doc/news.txt) (`:help news` in Nvim)

## Install

### Windows

#### Zip

1. Download **nvim-win64.zip** (or **nvim-win-arm64.zip** for ARM)
2. Extract the zip
3. Run `nvim.exe` in your terminal

#### MSI

1. Download **nvim-win64.msi** (or **nvim-win-arm64.msi** for ARM)
2. Run the MSI
3. Run `nvim.exe` in your terminal

Note: On Windows "Server" you may need to [install `vcruntime*.dll`](https://neovim.io/doc/install/#windows).

### macOS (x86_64)

1. Download **nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz**
2. Run `xattr -c ./nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz` (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
3. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz`
4. Run `./nvim-macos-x86_64/bin/nvim`

### macOS (arm64)

1. Download **nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz**
2. Run `xattr -c ./nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz` (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
3. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz`
4. Run `./nvim-macos-arm64/bin/nvim`

### Linux (x86_64)

If your system does not have the required glibc version, try the (unsupported) [builds for older glibc](https://github.com/neovim/neovim-releases).

#### AppImage

1. Download **nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage**
2. Run `chmod u+x nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage`
   - If your system does not have FUSE you can [extract the appimage](https://github.com/AppImage/AppImageKit/wiki/FUSE#type-2-appimage):
     ```bash
     ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage --appimage-extract
     ./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim
     ```

#### Tarball

1. Download **nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz**
2. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`
3. Run `./nvim-linux-x86_64/bin/nvim`

### Linux (arm64)

#### AppImage

1. Download **nvim-linux-arm64.appimage**
2. Run `chmod u+x nvim-linux-arm64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage`
   - If your system does not have FUSE you can [extract the appimage](https://github.com/AppImage/AppImageKit/wiki/FUSE#type-2-appimage):
     ```bash
     ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage --appimage-extract
     ./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim
     ```

#### Tarball

1. Download **nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz**
2. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz`
3. Run `./nvim-linux-arm64/bin/nvim`

### Other

- Install by [package manager](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/blob/master/INSTALL.md#install-from-package)

name: v1.4.243
body:
## Chrome extensions in Orca’s browser, iPhone Duo support, and Convert a terminal agent session live into a chat ui 🧩

This release brings Chrome extensions to Orca’s browser under experimental, lets a conversation continue in Chat once you quit its agent in the terminal, and shows your local worktrees sooner after a restart. It also adds support for the folding iPhone Duo, compact native-style menus, light and dark themes on the phone, and fixes for Windows terminals, SSH hosts and updates.

## The short version

- **Chrome extensions (experimental):** Add extensions from the Chrome Web Store with **Add to Orca**, so password managers like Bitwarden and 1Password can fill logins in Orca’s browser. Off by default.
- **Convert a terminal agent session live into a chat ui:** Once you quit Claude or Codex in a terminal, the same conversation can continue in Chat while the terminal tab stays open. Claude chats also keep their saved approval choice across model changes, and closing a chat that’s still working asks first.
- **Worktrees sooner after a restart:** Local worktrees load before terminals restore, and the sidebar says discovery is still running instead of showing an empty list.
- **Steadier terminals:** Windows terminals keep their history through width changes, slept terminals wake in the folder you left, macOS’s built-in bash keeps command tracking in order after a DEBUG trap change, and copying from pi on a remote host reaches your clipboard.
- **Orchestration:** Choose the worker heartbeat interval or turn heartbeats off, and reduce CPU use by stopping settled workers from polling for commands.
- **Polish where it counts:** Compact native-style menus, VS Code–style Markdown highlighting with sticky headings, and update checks through your Settings proxy.
- **Fixes from the community:** Quit and Stop All Sessions, math in chats, Copy Remote URL with line ranges, IME highlighting in terminals, fnm on Windows, and Japanese and Chinese translations all work better.

**Phone & web updates:** Phones get light and dark themes, support for the folding iPhone Duo, PDFs in Quick Look and copy buttons in chats. Many phone screens now follow desktop’s rules for chats, Source Control and terminals, and typing and scrolling in long chats stay fast.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Fresh terminal host:** New terminals start on a fresh terminal host so this release’s terminal fixes apply, including continuing a chat after its terminal agent exits. Terminals already open before you update keep running, and stay attached, on the previous host until you close them.
- **Browser extensions (experimental):** Turn on **Settings → Experimental → Browser extensions**, restart, then open the Chrome Web Store in an Orca browser tab. Extensions run in local browser profiles only. Ad blockers install but don’t block yet, and some extensions, such as Tampermonkey, don’t work.
- **Worker heartbeats:** Heartbeats stay on every 5 minutes by default. Changes in **Settings → Agent Orchestration** apply to newly dispatched workers; workers already running keep their brief, and older hosts keep 5 minutes.
- **Claude subagent navigation:** The eye that marked the subagent you’re viewing is gone. The viewed subagent row uses the normal current-row highlight.

---

## Product experience

### Browser

*Chrome extensions under experimental, cookie imports that keep you signed in, and agent clicks that land.*

* Install Chrome extensions, such as password managers, from the Chrome Web Store into Orca’s browser (experimental, off by default) by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30940
* Import cookies without signing the browser out of sites by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34113
* Show cookie import as available in Browser Use settings before skill setup by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34097
* Say when secret-tool is missing on Linux cookie import instead of blaming the keyring by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34099
* Scroll off-screen elements into view before agent clicks and hovers by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34262
* Deliver agent clicks and keys to pages that loaded while their pane was hidden by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34291
* Paste your local clipboard into streamed browser pages by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34269
* Copy and cut from streamed browser pages to your local clipboard by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34290
* Ship the browser automation helper’s skill guides with desktop builds by @zerone0x in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/17714
* Keep an Annotate session going when the page loads an iframe by @Brant-lzh in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24032
* Remove a deleted server’s browser data without a Windows “resource busy” error by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33280
* Open HTML preview links in your preferred browser, honoring modifier keys by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33622
* Open new-tab file links from a local HTML page in an Orca tab by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34057
* Focus newly opened image tabs by @hwantage in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34127
* Apply `orca set media --reduced-motion`, and reject unknown values by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34253
* Pick and track elements inside open shadow roots with Grab page element by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34265
* Keep annotation badges when a page updates its URL fragment while scrolling by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34267
* Pass `orca wait --timeout` through to the browser driver by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34283
* Type text that starts with a dash literally in browser commands by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34289
* Keep the Annotate pick armed when a page rewrites its URL fragment by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34423
* Stop malformed localhost pages from freezing the new tab page by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34427

### Native chat (experimental)

*Continue in Chat after the terminal agent exits, keep Claude’s approval choice, and type with less lag.*

* Continue a conversation in Chat once its terminal agent has exited, while the terminal tab stays open by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33759
* Keep a Claude chat’s saved approval choice across model changes, without the delivery freeze that pulled the earlier fix by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34031
* Ask before closing a chat that’s still working by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34236
* Hand off a chat tab’s work to another agent from its right-click menu by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34504
* Drag to reorder queued messages on desktop and phone by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34026
* Stop hidden chats re-rendering on every tab change, easing typing lag by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34020
* Stop a flapping paired host from re-rendering every chat by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34300
* Share one chat history render across readers, cutting host work per streamed update by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34215
* Load chat agent code the first time a chat needs it, not at startup by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34318
* Show Codex compaction markers in chat transcripts by @erishforG in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/14765
* Render math in chats and center standalone equations by @xinzhoulvxinda in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31546
* Make the Chat UI ⇄ terminal shortcut remappable by @SamuelAdigos in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31679
* Keep damaged saved chats readable without letting them take new agent actions by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31931
* Remember the model an OpenCode chat actually runs, not the one it reports at startup by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32006
* Keep a new chat usable when the tab list lags behind its creation by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33620
* Keep a reply’s thinking above its answer as older history loads by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33628
* Pass / commands an agent says it handles, like OMP’s /fast, through to the session by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34048
* Stop ordinary chat replies without reading through the chat’s history first by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34320
* Share one capped Codex process per account for resting chats’ skill checks by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34349
* Show a Claude message once after reopening a chat closed before Claude acknowledged it by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34355
* Open /D:/ chat file links on the right drive in Windows workspaces by @bbingz in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34367
* List an idle Claude chat’s / commands from the account it will start on by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34429
* Open chat name settings from a naming failure by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34533

### Agent launch, status & accounts

*Antigravity usage that explains itself, restored agents that take startup answers, and calmer subagent rows.*

* Remove the eye icon marking the Claude subagent you’re viewing by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34558
* Let you answer a startup prompt, such as a passphrase, while a saved agent terminal restores by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30978
* Keep your configured Codex command when restarting Codex before it records a session by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33629
* Keep the Codex app’s bundled plugins available in Orca-managed Codex homes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33621
* Keep account-switch restarts of hidden Claude panes from counting against the eight-session limit by @thefrikidude in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34403
* Restart panes in the right workspace when switching accounts and IDs repeat across hosts by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34214
* Launch Claude Agent Teams on Orca servers with the `orca` command they install by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34116
* Tell agents about Orca’s public-link publishing only when it’s turned on by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34547
* Show live Codex usage on the active account row, including System default by @moonrailgun in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20842
* Report a skill publish or install the cloud rejected as a cloud failure, and retry brief server errors by @L4XB in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20848
* Detect Codex’s footer when the shortcut help sits under its status row by @v01dstar in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24338
* Keep an async setting you added to Orca’s Claude hooks across reinstalls by @1aifanatic in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26736
* Name OMP subagent rows and clear finished ones so the pane stops showing Working by @kiendle in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29263
* Price GPT-6.1 Sol in Codex cost estimates by @tianlrz in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29707
* Close other row menus in Session History when you open one by @umi008 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31801
* Allow OpenCode model picks when model discovery fails by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31985
* Show how an ACP agent exited, and keep its error output as a log detail by @anmol0b in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33190
* Save an Antigravity account whose sign-in has no ID token by @thefrikidude in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33580
* Start a private OpenCode 2 server only when another data folder holds its port by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33784
* Add Orca’s hooks to jcode hook lists you already defined in config.toml by @TheophileDiot in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33999
* Show agy’s own error when reading Antigravity usage fails by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34106
* Keep Antigravity panes working until their helper subagents finish by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34128
* Show Antigravity usage for a login Orca can’t identify instead of “account changed” by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34159
* Show an Antigravity login with no quota as unavailable, not “Refresh failed” by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34163
* Stop opening a Google sign-in page every hour while Antigravity is signed out by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34165
* Keep OMP session titles when a turn finishes by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34266
* Recognize OMP and Pi tabs by their renamed session titles by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34292
* Stop showing a permission prompt for Pi and OMP sessions named “action required” by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34294
* Support list-form Kiro agent hooks written by `kiro-cli agent upgrade` by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34385

### Orchestration & CLI

*Choose worker heartbeats, keep settled workers from burning CPU, and target the right workspace.*

* Add a Settings switch to turn worker heartbeats off by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34070
* Choose how often workers send heartbeats by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34071
* Point dispatched workers at the orchestration skill, and stop their heartbeats before they report done by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34404
* Stop settled workers polling for / commands, which kept about 100 hidden Codex processes busy on Windows by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34342
* Let a sleeping chat’s background commands send orchestration mail as that chat by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34049
* Start a worker in a new worktree from anywhere when you name the repo by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34388
* Press Enter on a prompt Orca already pasted, even if the sending script disconnects by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34373
* Stop calling a worker’s prompt “submitted” when Orca couldn’t see the worker start by @innocarpe in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21453
* Run typed setup commands without a subshell wrapper so zsh-autopair can’t corrupt them by @mmarabel in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22537
* Keep a record in each Run of what `orca orchestration reset --tasks` cleared by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28823
* Target the calling terminal’s own workspace in folder projects from the CLI by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33703

### Terminals

*A fresh terminal host, Windows history that survives resizes, and terminals that wake where you left them.*

* Start new terminals on a fresh terminal host so this release’s terminal fixes apply by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34627
* Keep Windows terminal history intact when a terminal’s width changes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34061
* Wake a slept terminal in the folder you left it in, with its prompt on a fresh row by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34172
* Stop a woken terminal’s prompt showing twice after a relaunch by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34060
* Keep command tracking in order on macOS’s bash 3.2 and other older bash after a DEBUG trap change by @mkjung in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29165
* Copy from pi’s full-screen view on a remote host to your own clipboard by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34102
* Keep keys typed into a brand-new WSL or paired-server terminal before its shell starts by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33859
* Resume a restored host pane’s agent from its saved session instead of replaying the launch command by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34054
* Keep a background tab whose program exited restorable, instead of treating it as closed by you by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34083
* Keep WSL terminal tabs and their history when the distro shuts down or crashes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34095
* Restore a WSL terminal whose distro stopped with its saved output after a relaunch by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34200
* Delete a kept WSL terminal’s saved output when you close it after a relaunch by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34205
* Let terminal tools on macOS ask for Contacts, Calendars and Reminders access by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34401
* Stop scrolling from sending invalid mouse positions to terminal programs by @Meapri in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23330
* Highlight the part of IME input being converted in the terminal by @akiya3 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27903

### SSH, WSL & remote servers

*SSH hosts that move with their automations, host files outside workspaces, and WSL distros that stop when idle.*

* Move an SSH host’s enabled automations to its Orca server so the host can connect by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34044
* Show Move anyway on an SSH host card when saved items block its move by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33961
* Make Move anyway the next step everywhere saved items block an SSH host’s move by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34041
* Lead an SSH connect failure with what to do about it by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33990
* Keep an SSH host’s server removed after Stop and remove, across reloads and restarts by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34107
* Start a stopped SSH host server that a recycled process ID hid on hosts without ps by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34519
* Keep the IME’s confirming Enter from submitting the port-forward dialog by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34315
* Open host files outside workspaces from any paired client allowed to run terminals by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33958
* Edit and save host files outside workspaces from a paired desktop by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34119
* Remove a paired-server project while its server is offline by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34079
* Keep a paired server’s remembered tab in step with the tab this desktop shows by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34082
* Keep a paired host’s custom board columns on the desktop that views it by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34362
* Add a folder once when two adds race on a paired server by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34303
* Let a supervised `orca serve` on macOS update when its profile path is spelled differently by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34570
* Use the app’s bundled browser driver for `orca serve` by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34111
* Install the app’s browser driver alongside the local `orca serve` server by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34150
* Remove a deleted recipe workspace’s VM from the sidebar right away by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34101
* Keep saved sessions for servers that are still saved but hidden from the server list by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34134
* Run desktop automations for projects on an SSH or WSL host’s server instead of having every run rejected by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34525
* Let an idle WSL distro stop once its Orca server has gone idle by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33084
* Start only the WSL host you focus, and keep a stopped one off by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33838
* Start booting the last-focused WSL host early at launch by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33924
* Start a WSL host’s distro when one of its automations is due by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33839
* Connect to a WSL host sooner on focus when no connection exists yet by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33110
* Restart a WSL host’s server that vanished after a cold start, instead of leaving a dead pane by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33147
* Skip PR refreshes for a WSL host that is off, and say so in Checks by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33840
* Release WSL holder processes on uninstall and startup, and keep a partly removed host pending by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33843
* Close a WSL host’s local listener once it idles out or its distro stops by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34046
* Never boot a WSL distro that stopped during a background reconnect by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34050
* Wait out a WSL shutdown after a clean exit too, so the distro isn’t switched back on by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34063
* Stop background WSL reconnects showing Connecting, and keep recovery from booting a distro by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34093
* Return memory the WSL host’s server uses while starting to the system by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34187
* Keep the WSL agent-status relay down while its distro is stopped by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34195
* Keep background file reads and watching from starting a stopped WSL distro by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34222
* Keep background Git from starting a stopped WSL distro by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34231
* Keep your own GLIBC_TUNABLES for the WSL host’s server by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34248
* Clean up the WSL relay’s helper processes when a connection closes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34260
* Say why a WSL command failed when it printed no error by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34304
* Close WSL host channels cleanly so a leftover session doesn’t keep the distro running by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34307
* Wait out the full settle window after a WSL distro stops before checking it again by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34372
* Only trust a WSL running check that started after the settle window by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34374
* Note why an idle WSL distro stays running by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34534

### Source control & integrations

*AI fix actions use the + menu’s picker, and GitLab, GitHub Projects and Linear views show what they should.*

name: v0.8.212
body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.212

Released on 2026-10-28.

A model download that stalls now resumes instead of failing. Failures with --json answer in one shape, and check shows progress as it runs.

## Fixes

- **CLI:** Exit 2 for remaining flag validation errors ([2d3033c71](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2d3033c719bc82ea4a82fe4d7141e0669ab9a14d), [#6639](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6639)).
- **CLI:** Snapshot warns when a video on screen has no source to read a frame from ([b84762230](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b84762230f03dd182e950df93eb6849b86a12aec), [#6656](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6656)).
- **CLI:** Every --json failure answers with one envelope, and --json only where supported ([85efaece7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/85efaece7e11a3e420fb4d93b85230781e805942), [#6622](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6622)).
- **CLI:** A check page forces a WebGL drawing buffer but keeps no list of 2d canvases ([b6eaed7ca](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b6eaed7cae2a92e80955c1b8d40db129cb74230b), [#6650](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6650)).
- **Inspector:** Live queries see every composition, wherever the playhead is ([205c1a31d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/205c1a31d3b4f031e7a10ef6dec8b7581c743d1a), [#6651](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6651)).
- **CLI:** Resume a model download that stalls partway instead of failing ([ecad35a22](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ecad35a2254c98b84c9410072908c902eb3f7241), [#6649](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6649)).
- **Studio:** A thumbnail reader forgets a start's failures after a minute ([a88751d9d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a88751d9d68475c84542c2cbc3621742ddfccd76), [#6642](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6642)).
- **Studio Server:** The render route passes a MOV ProRes profile to the render ([5a0179b88](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5a0179b88eb3da0e10797288b0c3ce2435e33d66), [#6644](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6644)).
- **Engine:** A Windows browser that will not start says where and why ([7758d9b8f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7758d9b8fd507384573eb56ba84cc62fb20444c6), [#6647](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6647)).
- **CLI:** Add help [cmd], suggest the closest command or flag, and quiet the nags ([e2c915132](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e2c91513203ec9be1833840bcfb35183a3dcee8d), [#6621](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6621)).
- **CLI:** Check prints a progress line as each pass after overlap begins ([3d1c0764a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3d1c0764a018c5c0412c6273a54c87b6ce532ef7), [#6646](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6646)).

## Internal

- **Studio:** Wait for the first undo press before the edit that should block the second ([7112e4b6b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7112e4b6bff935dcdcfc475e20b3719d7585251d), [#6652](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6652)).
- Keep the bun cache warm and skip binary downloads in preflight ([0e32ee9b5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0e32ee9b56bd0815c0dc23a1c3fbb81aa8c43a87), [#6648](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6648)).

body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.211

Released on 2026-10-28.

Graded clips now draw on real GPUs instead of showing a blank frame, including clips zoomed far past the screen. New blank projects also start on black, not grey.

## Fixes

- **CLI:** Local servers never bind a port Chromium refuses to load from ([bf7ebe961](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bf7ebe961e522533fbbd9b94384198d662935ef5), [#6620](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6620)).
- **Dx:** Unblock lint and the Claude pre-commit hook on Windows ([310488b05](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/310488b0501e17a6e92db646575cdef54251f880), [#6619](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6619)).
- **CLI:** A new blank project starts on a black frame, not grey ([4f0bdfb52](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4f0bdfb520a7ccb54ca5a602936a3dd713089151), [#6614](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6614)).
- **Core:** A graded clip's canvas no longer comes out blank on a real GPU ([9eaf9efb6](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9eaf9efb69f37de0d6d98324bda1c65c9a924f2f), [#6615](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6615)).
- **Producer:** A path whose name starts with two dots now counts as inside its folder ([c8052fbda](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c8052fbdae3416f9db93ebd33f873228ce8996b6), [#5834](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5834)).

## Performance

- **CLI:** Check's craft pass skips clips the runtime has hidden ([815ff9ec8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/815ff9ec8d755b52c050943765bf15c9c9b1e88e), [#6627](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6627)).

## Docs & Examples

- **Audio:** Say the render sums tracks at unity and limits nothing ([8b1f88b3c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8b1f88b3c06175f43fbdbe1af6e53933847cb195), [#5652](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5652)).

## Internal

- **Codegen:** Resync cloud client from EF 354b4cf4 ([32e171ca9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/32e171ca91487c27f8d7c8b1f455b7c844a23e08), [#6608](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6608)).

name: v0.8.210
body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.210

Released on 2026-10-27.

MOV renders can now pick a ProRes profile, and HDR sources render correctly to formats that cannot carry HDR. A page whose renderer crashes now fails at once with a clear reason instead of hanging.

## Features

- **CLI:** Render --prores-profile picks ProRes 4444, hq, 422, lt or proxy for MOV ([957df5c268c66](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/957df5c268c6622c94879a701c845d35d72d1762), [#6581](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6581)).
- **CLI:** Doctor names the tested ffmpeg build and says loudness is only comparable on it ([98e774384efdc](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/98e774384efdc785c7d49947948e796a8b8b4004), [#6566](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6566)).

## Fixes

- **CLI:** A page whose renderer crashes fails at once, named as the crash ([439d6856780f0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/439d6856780f0525d1b1e4a75708c43f8f868536), [#6598](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6598)).
- **Producer:** HDR sources are tone-mapped for formats that cannot carry HDR ([313792408d641](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/313792408d641f702ea7624fd6abda10c957aab3), [#6597](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6597)).
- **Engine:** Extraction waits out the decode up to a deep seek in a long-GOP video ([3b2058a2b7a2e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3b2058a2b7a2ebb36abd5887c35aa48f7398a389), [#6583](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6583)).
- **Preview:** The proxy copy for the video at the playhead is made ahead of the rest ([bff39004b0312](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bff39004b0312ed903fbe0882ec31c6d0b1a0a25), [#6586](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6586)).
- **CLI:** Hyperframes add keeps going when Windows holds the file it replaces ([e21fd123fd8f8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e21fd123fd8f8f1e9231a08546a5bcd6a33b7227), [#6576](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6576)).
- **CLI:** A killed remove-background run no longer leaves its CoreML temp files behind ([0a703edc6f119](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0a703edc6f119bbdb8d42d48e259bb745b6cb620), [#6582](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6582)).
- **Engine:** Mux uppercase WebM exports with Opus audio ([1d4aadc1fb436](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1d4aadc1fb436daba83184ab8dd894df13513cef), [#6579](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6579)).
- **Producer:** Stop HDR video windows after the first from repeating one frame ([07b0f2cda1cf7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/07b0f2cda1cf7b51e0f12d0d05c304b37b4e881c), [#6575](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6575)).
- **CLI:** Check fails a full-frame element that covers every other clip, naming it ([2a0fa7f4de970](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2a0fa7f4de9704ef5dd8f88b0e974383914e6c3f), [#6572](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6572)).
- **CLI:** A failed --against reference no longer also says it has no frame ([696ca8f779cd3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/696ca8f779cd36bfef53102658722c46e9c3e522), [#6574](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6574)).
- **AWS Lambda:** A network blip no longer stops the release ffmpeg build ([8cd9c517c79be](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8cd9c517c79be5ada1878ba58bdffeac6cfe39eb), [#6569](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6569)).
- **CLI:** Capture waits for a mid-read navigation to settle and reads the page again once ([013fe4e18ad7c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/013fe4e18ad7c4aa43eb23967abd27ea4e16bf33), [#6567](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6567)).
- **CLI:** A capture DNS helper that dies silently says how it ended ([d571d77cae9d8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d571d77cae9d8ea7ffc1ec7262855fb4905ed859), [#6570](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6570)).

- **CLI:** A snapshot clip whose frame fails is named with ffmpeg's reason ([7a0c75bb69925](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7a0c75bb69925205eacd109433fb45ff4385bcae), [#6564](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6564)).

# HyperFrames v0.8.209

Released on 2026-10-27.

Chrome now closes quickly in every managed browser, and audio effects launch it like other renders. Previews load project media and HDR clips the way render does.

## Fixes

- Phone videos with an undecodable first audio track check, preview and render ([cfef528d3ae1d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cfef528d3ae1d4549db648242e8f4c9cc7524d71), [#6551](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6551)).
- **CLI:** An element marked data-layout-ignore no longer counts as covering text ([41a7bc98f77b2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/41a7bc98f77b2019b98f0401a7e813e978ef111c), [#6555](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6555)).
- **Studio Server:** An HDR clip previews and snapshots the way the SDR export renders it ([404e8254e6ad0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/404e8254e6ad07c02f1b83f654500a3656059bd5), [#6537](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6537)).
- **Studio Server:** Preview loads root-path media, images and CSS from the project, as render does ([60927853485dd](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/60927853485ddeb4ed7d8bdf19047be3b384cd20), [#6552](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6552)).

## Internal

- **Studio:** Record each edit-accuracy shard's file writes and reloads when HF_WRITE_TRACE is set ([58552ede4bfff](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/58552ede4bfff5366fa535551845d20cda3f2875), [#6532](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6532)).

body: ### 18 new icons: - `outline/archive-restore` - `outline/beach-bag` - `outline/book-clone` - `outline/brand-misskey` - `outline/brand-viber` - `outline/decagram` - `outline/git-merge-ai` - `outline/git-pull-request-closed-ai` - `outline/git-pull-request-draft-ai` - `outline/git-pull-request-locked-ai` - `outline/loop` - `outline/map-pins-off` - `outline/mcp` - `outline/opacity` - `outline/pencil-ruler` - `outline/snail` - `outline/world-map-off` - `outline/zsh` ### New features - **Webfont:** Split the webfont into chunks loaded with `unicode-range`: one with the 300 most popular icons and one per icon category (for the filled font: the popular icons and the rest). A page now downloads only the chunks with the icons it shows, e.g. about 40 KB instead of about 500 KB when it uses only popular icons. Set `$ti-font-split: false` in SCSS to load the single font file as before. (#1654) ### Fixes and improvements - **React Native:** Fix `color` being ignored by the icon nodes that fill with `currentColor` (e.g. `IconSquareRoundedCheckFilled`, the dot of `IconAccessible`): the root `Svg` now gets `color`, which react-native-svg resolves `currentColor` to (#1668)

name: v18.13.3
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

### Changed

- Updated Bun engine requirement to ≥1.4.4

### Fixed

- Fixed chat-completions context estimates counting past thinking that the request drops (no reasoning replay), which triggered compaction far below the threshold ([#15797](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15797), [#17231](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17231) by [@ghisguth](https://github.com/ghisguth))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-ai

### Changed

- Updated Bun engine requirement to ≥1.4.4

## @oh-my-pi/browser-relay

### Changed

- Updated Bun engine requirement to ≥1.4.4

## @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

### Added

- Added DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 to the Factory Droid provider for accounts with Factory's 1017 flag; turning thinking off on its Baseten route disables reasoning instead of falling back to low effort ([#17234](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17234) by [@skipper019](https://github.com/skipper019))

### Changed

- Made Kimi Code model discovery authoritative and cached per credential, added K3.1 Pro and K3.1 Pro Highspeed to the bundled Kimi Code catalog, and preserved live thinking metadata there ([#17224](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17224) by [@trukhinyuri](https://github.com/trukhinyuri))
- Updated Bun engine requirement to ≥1.4.4

### Fixed

- Codex model refresh now lists models available to an entitled account even when other saved accounts return HTTP 402 ([#17198](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17198)).
- LiteLLM discovery now reads every `/v2/model/info` page before selecting the proxy's model roster, rather than caching only the first 50 entries; malformed or incomplete pagination falls back without caching a partial page ([#17237](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17237) by [@maykonmichel](https://github.com/maykonmichel)).
- Fixed hosted web search on OpenAI Responses and Codex Responses selecting GPT-5.6 Luna instead of GPT-6 Luna ([#17202](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17202) by [@mateo-bolanos](https://github.com/mateo-bolanos)).

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Added

- Manual compactions (RPC `compact`, `/compact`, extension `ctx.compact()`) emit `manual_compaction_start` and `manual_compaction_end` session events, so RPC hosts can show compaction progress; `docs/rpc.md` documents these with the other progress events (`retry_fallback_applied`, `ttsr_triggered`, `goal_updated`) ([#17247](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17247) by [@Quelaan1](https://github.com/Quelaan1))
- Added `retry.rateLimitWalksChain` (default `false`): with it on, a 429 rate limit after a turn with signed Claude thinking moves to the next model in `retry.fallbackChains` at once instead of retrying the throttled model until `retry.maxRetries` is spent ([#17232](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17232) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- Sessions can be renamed from the resume picker: the new title persists as a user title without loading the session, and renames of live sessions are refused instead of forking the transcript ([#17262](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17262) by [@Twilight0](https://github.com/Twilight0))
- Added `display.advisorCollapsedLines` (Settings → Appearance → Display) to cap how many note lines a collapsed advisor card shows; the default keeps the full preview ([#17228](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17228) by [@bluecapone](https://github.com/bluecapone))
- `omp config list --scope global|project` lists only the keys that layer sets, with the values as written: path-scoped `enabledModels`, `enabledProviders` and `disabledProviders` entries (`{ path, … }`) stay unresolved, so a host can edit the global value without dropping them ([#17246](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17246) by [@Quelaan1](https://github.com/Quelaan1))
- `tools.xdevNotices: false` hides the `xd://: mounted …` notices shown as MCP servers connect, without turning on `startup.quiet` ([#17263](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17263) by [@MaisonnatM](https://github.com/MaisonnatM))

### Changed

- Updated Bun engine requirement to ≥1.4.4

### Fixed

- A running job's glance keeps the whole a meter counts instead of the bare numerator: a widget whose headline restated `140` beside a `140/190` bar now draws `140/190` in the job card, the HUD pill and the status line ([#17226](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17226) by [@iacore](https://github.com/iacore))
- Fixed the managed-skills root guard rejecting a symlinked store outright; a root that resolves to a directory now accepts writes inside its target, while a broken link or a link to a non-directory is still refused ([#17201](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17201) by [@iacore](https://github.com/iacore))
- Fixed experimental context rollover repeatedly running during tool calls when the fixed prompt and tool schemas already exceed the recovery band ([#17205](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17205))
- Fixed Ctrl+D during deferred extension startup falsely reporting an extension exit error and exiting 1 instead of closing cleanly ([#17259](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17259)).
- Resuming a session, or reviving a parked or restored subagent, after a prewalk or plan-yolo handoff continues on the model and effort the handoff switched to instead of falling back to the planning model ([#17229](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17229) by [@shgew](https://github.com/shgew))
- Fixed one interrupt silently stopping a session from ever waking on its own background job results again: an interrupt (Esc, the RPC `abort` command, an ACP cancel, a collab guest stop, an extension's `ctx.abort()`) that stops no run and no queued work no longer suppresses those wakes, and after an interrupt that did stop a run they come back once a later turn has run and ended. Esc on the "waiting on background jobs" row still ends that wait: its results land in context for your next prompt, as before ([#17243](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17243) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- Fixed `!` commands on zsh/fish waiting forever at interactive prompts (e.g. the Oh My Zsh update question on `!code .`); keystrokes now go to the running command while it runs, and Esc still cancels ([#17210](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17210))
- Fixed auto-compaction firing early on OpenAI-compatible chat-completions models that don't replay past reasoning ([#15797](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15797), [#17231](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17231) by [@ghisguth](https://github.com/ghisguth))
- Eval's `tool.<name>(…)` now accepts `xd://<name>` and the Claude Code `mcp__<server>__<tool>` spelling like direct tool calls, and reports registered but unavailable tools instead of "Unknown tool" ([#17250](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17250))
- Updated the `ask` prompt to encourage assistants to show missing decision context before the dialog opens ([#17242](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17242) by [@jasonharrison](https://github.com/jasonharrison))
- Custom LiteLLM providers now refresh cached model rosters after paginated `/v2/model/info` discovery was fixed; cached first-page-only lists no longer hide later-page models ([#17237](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17237) by [@maykonmichel](https://github.com/maykonmichel)).
- Fixed hosted search repeating the same request when the active model is also its search target but uses a cloned or refitted model object ([#17202](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17202) by [@mateo-bolanos](https://github.com/mateo-bolanos)).
- Fixed a killed or failed inline browser tab worker keeping its connection to the browser relay, which left Chrome's "started debugging this browser" bar on every tab until the omp session exited ([#17212](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17212) by [@nickzitzer](https://github.com/nickzitzer))
- Fixed a live tool card dropping the model's `i` intent, which the harness strips from the args `tool_execution_start` carries; the card now keeps it, so a bash call in Tern shows its description instead of a bare "Bash" as it already did in a resumed session ([#17197](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17197) by [@iacore](https://github.com/iacore))
- RPC sessions now report settled (`isSettled: true`, `session_settled`) after a turn whose failed `todo` call queued a reminder for the next prompt, instead of appearing busy until another prompt arrives ([#17238](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17238) by [@kmccleary3301](https://github.com/kmccleary3301))
- `/annotate` keeps notes and an unfinished note when the overlay is closed without sending them: reopening the same source restores them, **Saved draft** resumes any of the session's drafts, and **Discard notes and close** drops one ([#17271](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17271) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC), based on [#17230](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17230) by [@Shadorain](https://github.com/Shadorain)).
- Annotation feedback names each note's source line, so notes on blank or repeated lines stay distinguishable ([#17271](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17271) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC), based on [#17230](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17230) by [@Shadorain](https://github.com/Shadorain)).
- Fixed `/tan` clones ending without a final answer when they call `ask`; the clone now keeps running and the parent receives its final answer instead of an empty result ([#17223](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17223) by [@trukhinyuri](https://github.com/trukhinyuri))
- Pasting in a terminal with enhanced paste (Tern, kitty) now lands in the open dialog's field — the agents hub's New agent description, an /annotate note — instead of the hidden prompt
- Pasting or dropping an image file into the prompt in a terminal with enhanced paste (Tern, kitty) now attaches the image instead of typing its path
- The plan review's edit button in Tern names your editor ("Edit in Notepad", "Edit in nvim") instead of "Edit in $EDITOR"
- Fixed GitHub `/review` diff links keeping the snapshot that built the request after the cached diff refreshes in the background, instead of opening whatever file now sits at the same index ([#16310](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16310) by [@tkossak](https://github.com/tkossak))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Added

- The resume picker renames the selected session in place: F2 opens a dialog prefilled with the current title, Enter commits, Esc cancels ([#17262](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17262) by [@Twilight0](https://github.com/Twilight0))

### Changed

- Updated Bun engine requirement to ≥1.4.4

### Fixed

- Restored WebP and JPEG images stay visible in Kitty scrollback after resuming a session ([#17220](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17220)).
- Escape in an annotation note no longer discards it: the overlay closes and `getDraft()`/`restoreDraft()` let the host keep and reopen the note; **Discard notes and close** (confirmed by a second press) clears them instead, and code review's actions start on Paste so a stray Enter never sends the LLM review ([#17271](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17271) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC), based on [#17230](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17230) by [@Shadorain](https://github.com/Shadorain)).
- Fixed terminal replies such as Tern's `tsp;e;{"ev":"ack",…}` showing up in the shell prompt after quitting omp; the exit drain now waits for the terminal to answer a final DA1 sentinel
- Fixed the plan review sheet in Tern squeezing the "continue with" model tiers under a long plan, so the model name overlapped the tier buttons
- `/usage` in Tern shows when each quota resets as a countdown (`resets in 2h30m`) instead of a clock time; hovering shows the date and time
- Fixed extension `ui.select` dialogs treating unconfigured `j`/`k` keys as navigation, which could turn a default No into Yes when typing `ok` then Enter ([#17255](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17255) by [@SAKANA-MOONLIGHT](https://github.com/SAKANA-MOONLIGHT)).

### Removed

- Removed support for the TSP `t` (theme) verb, as surface theme synchronization is no longer required

name: v18.13.2
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

### Added

- `AgentTool` gained the optional `handlesToolInterrupt` flag: an interruptible tool that sets it (such as `wait`) still runs, without blocking, when a loop-owned interrupt is already queued, so it can drain the queued wake event instead of being skipped; user cancellation still skips it ([#17174](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17174) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-ai

### Fixed

- Fixed OAuth logins shared by several processes being disabled with `invalid_grant` when they refreshed at the same time or one of them quit mid-refresh ([#17128](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17128) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- Fixed transient Google 429 rate-limit and capacity responses retrying in place without blocking or rotating credentials, while daily caps and zero-entitlement limits still rotate ([#17127](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17127) by [@GTanger](https://github.com/GTanger))
- Fixed Aliyun DashScope's multimodal gateway failing a turn on its intermittent `InvalidParameter` 400s for valid inline images ("provided URL does not appear to be valid", "Download multimodal file timed out"); they are now retried ([#17101](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17101) by [@shuairongzeng](https://github.com/shuairongzeng))
- Fixed a revoked or rejected GitHub Copilot credential continuing to show its last cached usage quota instead of being dropped ([#17081](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17081))
- Fixed Devin requests compressing the request body on the UI thread, which briefly froze the TUI on long conversations; requests under 1 KiB are now sent uncompressed

## @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

### Added

- Added LM Studio decision models to discovery: models LM Studio reports as `type: "decision"` are listed as `judge` models served over its `/v1/decisions` endpoint, alongside its chat models ([#17169](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17169) by [@richiestanaway](https://github.com/richiestanaway))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Added

- Extensions in the interactive TUI can read and directly switch plan, vibe, goal, and loop modes with `ctx.sessionModes` and observe changes with the `mode_changed` event, without submitting slash commands; `extensionHandlers.modeControl: false` turns off extension-driven mode changes ([#15753](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15753) by [@Shadorain](https://github.com/Shadorain))
- RPC hosts can capture draft-only speech-to-text with live previews when speech input is enabled, without submitting an agent turn; slow flushes have adjustable deadlines, and failed transcription does not block a session change after capture closes ([#17158](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17158) by [@felipe-santos-aya](https://github.com/felipe-santos-aya)).
- Added `discovery.advertisedReasoning` to let a custom provider opt out of the reasoning ladder its `/v1/models` rows advertise (default `true`); `discovery: proxy` now reads that ladder, its `none` off-switch, and an explicit `reasoning: false` instead of building every model's thinking surface from the bundled catalog reference alone ([#15255](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15255), [#17077](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17077) by [@Youwenqwq](https://github.com/Youwenqwq))
- `WATCHDOG.yml` advisor entries now accept `scope` (`main`, `subagent`, or `all`, default `all`) to attach an advisor only to the top-level session or only to advised subagents, and `includeReasoning: false` to omit primary assistant `_thinking:_` blocks from advisor review deltas ([#17058](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17058) by [@trukhinyuri](https://github.com/trukhinyuri))
- Added `session.worktreeScope` to keep the resume picker scoped to one directory ([#17061](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17061) by [@Dante-dan](https://github.com/Dante-dan)).
- LM Studio decision models can now serve the `judge` role (`modelRoles.judge: lm-studio/<model>`); they answer over LM Studio's `/v1/decisions` endpoint instead of being offered as chat models ([#17169](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17169) by [@richiestanaway](https://github.com/richiestanaway))
- Extensions' `getAllTools()` now reports `mcpServerName`, `mcpToolName` and `mcpReadOnlyHint` for MCP-backed tools, so an extension can tell read-only connector tools from ones that change things ([#17120](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17120) by [@cfpperche](https://github.com/cfpperche))
- RPC: `navigate_tree` (move the leaf in the same session file, optionally summarizing the abandoned branch), `abort_branch_summary` and `set_label`, with matching `RpcClient` methods ([#17138](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17138) by [@andrebrait](https://github.com/andrebrait))
- RPC: delta `message_update` frames (`messageUpdates: "delta"`) now carry the block on start/end events and the message on a restart, so a client can rebuild the streaming message from deltas alone ([#17137](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17137) by [@andrebrait](https://github.com/andrebrait))
- `ctx.ui.input` now accepts `{ secret: true }` to mask typed characters as bullets in the TUI, forward an optional `secret` host hint on RPC `extension_ui_request` frames, and refuse plaintext form elicitation in ACP mode ([#17080](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17080) by [@GTanger](https://github.com/GTanger))
- Added opt-in `gc.autoCompress` (default off): interactive launches start a detached, low-priority `omp gc --compress --apply` at most once a day, so idle sessions are stored compressed without running the command; volumes where compression does not shrink a probe file (e.g. macOS 27) are skipped, and the latest run's output or skip reason is in `gc-auto-compress.log` in the agent dir ([#17189](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17189) by [@wolfiesch](https://github.com/wolfiesch))
- Added `withFatLto` to the Nix package: `omp.override { withFatLto = false; }` links `pi-natives` with thin LTO for faster builds ([#13752](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/13752) by [@n3oney](https://github.com/n3oney))

### Changed

- Bundled `scout` subagents now include `ast_grep` in their default tool list, matching the agent prompt's AST-search directive; `scout` stays read-only, so `lsp` (which can rename and apply code actions) is not added ([#17151](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17151) by [@sinhduc01](https://github.com/sinhduc01))
- Clearing a draft now brings back the idle recap and idle compaction it held off, a subagent view you return to gets the recap it still owed, and prompts, turn-starting messages and IRC wakes that arrive during idle compaction wait for it to finish; SDK owners can opt a session in with `AgentSession.enableIdleMaintenance({ isBlocked, scheduledTurn, onRecap })` and `refreshIdleMaintenance()` ([#17136](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17136) by [@andrebrait](https://github.com/andrebrait))
- TTSR interrupts include a bounded excerpt of the text that matched the rule, quoted as untrusted data with harness tags escaped; excerpts are retained once per stream, preserved alongside AST matches, and omitted for zero-width matches ([#17099](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17099) by [@shgew](https://github.com/shgew))
- Sessions that load several provider-registering extensions into a shared model registry (subagents, `/tan`, SDK hosts) start faster: the model catalog is rebuilt once instead of once per extension ([#17088](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17088) by [@Delije4](https://github.com/Delije4))
- Qwen 3.8 models (for example `Qwen3.8-Flash-Next` served locally) now get the `replace` edit tool instead of hashline, like Kimi, DeepSeek and GLM 5.3 Flash; an explicit `edit.mode`, `edit.modelVariants`, `PI_EDIT_VARIANT` or `PI_STRICT_EDIT_MODE` still wins ([#17096](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17096) by [@ianderse](https://github.com/ianderse))
- ACP clients now receive each tool's name on `tool_call`, so tools without a specific ACP kind (`task`, `wait`, `ask`, …) show their own name instead of a generic "tool" label ([#17162](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17162) by [@epk](https://github.com/epk))
- `/context` now opens an interactive, read-only viewer of the active prompt, tools, messages, and thinking with estimated token usage and per-tool output, instead of the static usage report ([#16160](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16160) by [@C-W-Z](https://github.com/C-W-Z)).
- Nix builds cache Rust dependencies and the native addon in separate derivations, so Rust edits no longer recompile every dependency and TypeScript edits reuse the addon ([#13752](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/13752) by [@n3oney](https://github.com/n3oney))

### Fixed

- Fixed `ask` questions being unanswerable while the prompt held a draft: Up/Down now hand the keyboard to the question (typing still goes to the draft until then), and the untouched draft is back in the prompt once the question is answered or cancelled ([#17215](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17215) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Fixed the Agent Hub becoming unreachable after the last subagent finished: the people icon now stays (muted) while the session has subagents to inspect, and `/subagents` opens the hub as an alias of `/hub` ([#17215](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17215) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Fixed `/goal pause` leaving the `goal` tool active; pausing now restores the toolset from before the goal started ([#15753](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15753) by [@Shadorain](https://github.com/Shadorain))
- Fixed `/live` flipping between `listening` and `speaking` at every pause in the assistant's speech; `speaking` now holds through short pauses ([#17114](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17114))
- Fixed the `workflowz` notice showing Python call forms in JS-only sessions and describing keep-alive workers when `eval.workpool.freshAgents` is on ([#17152](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17152) by [@bigHippoZz](https://github.com/bigHippoZz))
- Fixed the first request after midnight or a working-directory change rewriting the conversation's first message, which broke OpenAI response chaining and the provider prompt cache, when an extension `context` handler or secret obfuscation was active, when an extension inserted its own message afresh on every request (superpowers' bootstrap), or when requests from one or more advisors ran in between; the new date or directory is now appended after the earlier turns, and is repeated when a side question (`/btw`) or a branch left out the turn that carried it ([#17117](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17117) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- Fixed `:auto` on a retry fallback entry being ignored: a fixed-effort session now switches to auto thinking on that fallback instead of inheriting the failing turn's effort, and advisor fallbacks keep following the primary's effort without enabling unverified thinking ([#17100](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17100) by [@shgew](https://github.com/shgew))
- Fixed `ssh://` home-relative paths resolving against literal `/~` instead of the remote account's home ([#17182](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17182) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))
- Fixed searches of `ssh://` directories failing with unsupported directory scans ([#17182](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17182) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))
- Fixed clone-first worktrees carrying source-bound Python environments and CMake build trees, including self-ignored and nested directories ([#17181](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17181) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))
- Fixed clean cloned worktrees carrying files ignored only by the source checkout, while retaining caches ignored by the target ([#17181](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17181) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))
- Fixed glob patterns ending in `/` returning no directories or including matching files; directory-only constraints now work across local, URL, and multi-root searches ([#17180](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17180) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))
- Fixed recursive `skill://` glob and find discovery skipping contained linked directories; linked resources keep their skill URLs and directory cycles terminate ([#17180](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17180) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))
- Fixed find treating nonempty linked files as empty and dropping them before judgment ([#17180](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17180) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))
- Fixed JSON selectors failing on BOM-prefixed input, backup and extensionless files, and modifier-only queries ([#17179](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17179) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))
- Fixed JSON selectors on `ssh://` text files while preserving pagination and the remote read limit ([#17179](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17179) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))
- Fixed `tool.apply_patch(...)` being rejected as an unknown tool in JavaScript eval when apply-patch editing is enabled ([#17178](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17178) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))
- Fixed eval silently changing supplied cell deadlines without showing the requested and effective timeouts ([#17178](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17178) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))
- Fixed unavailable Python remaining in eval's advertised languages and corrected its interpreter setup guidance ([#17178](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17178) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))
- Fixed PDF archive members returning a binary-entry banner instead of converted text, with PDF selectors and page-image reads now supported ([#17175](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17175) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))
- Fixed `github` `run_watch` labeling unavailable or partial failed-job logs as full logs, and included bounded fetch-failure reasons ([#17173](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17173) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))
- Fixed `github` `pr_create` echoing large PR bodies in creation summaries and `xd://github` result details ([#17173](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17173) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))
- Fixed raw URL reads prepending transport headers and normalizing response whitespace; raw URL bodies, ranges, and artifacts now share source-body coordinates ([#17171](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17171) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))
- Fixed raw ranged reads adding elision rows, continuation notices for satisfied ranges, and conflict instructions to selected source text ([#17171](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17171) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))
- Fixed `read` replacing a valid HTML page with a stale or missing guessed `.md` page; alternate representations now report their actual source URL ([#16834](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16834))
- Fixed implicit interactive `autoResume` failing every launch when a saved model cannot be restored and model fallback is disabled: startup now warns and opens a fresh session without carrying over the old history or cache identity, while preserving the original `--max-time` deadline. Saved-model diagnostics in the warning are sanitized and length-limited before display. Explicit resume and headless model-restoration restrictions remain unchanged ([#17163](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17163) by [@SAKANA-MOONLIGHT](https://github.com/SAKANA-MOONLIGHT)).
- Fixed `proc://<id>/mode` reporting a known in-process job or agent as a missing service, and clarified that stdin and lifetime modes are services-only ([#17170](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17170) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))
- Fixed Rex and other OSC 7501 terminals losing the `working` or `blocked` indicator when omp redraws a user message during a run ([#17145](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17145))
- Fixed hintless Google HTTP 429 model-capacity responses using the 45–75s model-capacity backoff instead of the short generic retry delay ([#17127](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17127) by [@GTanger](https://github.com/GTanger))
- Fixed `skill://` reads, `/skill:` commands (terminal, ACP and RPC) and subagent autoload skills serving a plugin's old version, or failing with `File not found`, in a running session after `omp plugin upgrade` installed a new version; the session now rediscovers its skills and uses the upgraded files, whether or not the old version's directory was deleted ([#17027](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17027) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- Fixed Esc on a busy session (and RPC `abort_and_restore_queue`) silently discarding queued messages from extensions and agents, such as `pi.sendMessage` steer/follow-up cards and agent-attributed prompts; they now appear in the transcript without restarting the run and reach the model with your next prompt ([#17161](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17161) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- Fixed a failed delivery of messages typed during compaction discarding other queued messages, such as an extension's prompt; only the messages that delivery queued are taken back, and messages anything else queued before, during or after it stay queued ([#17161](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17161) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- Fixed a failed delivery of messages typed during compaction sending the first of them twice: once now and again with the retried batch ([#17161](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17161) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- Fixed `--resume <file|id>`, `--continue`, `SessionManager.continueRecent()`, the resume pickers and RPC `open_session` reviving an old copy of a conversation that had continued in a new file because omp could not keep writing the original (another omp process held it, or the file changed under it); resume now opens the copy with the newest turn, unless the original has turns of its own that copy lacks (for `--resume`, the pickers, and `--continue` or auto-resume of the terminal's last session), and says which file it picked; `--continue` and auto-resume without a record of the terminal's last session, and RPC `open_session`, take the copy with the newest turn among all linked copies, whichever one was written last. Copies saved before this fix are not linked and still resume as before ([#17159](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17159) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- Fixed a `retry.fallbackChains` entry naming another Claude model being skipped while the latest Claude turn carries signed thinking: the chain now moves to that entry when the failure is on another model, is not retried (an account-policy denial, a non-retryable error, or a wait past `retry.maxDelayMs`), or has spent its retries ([#17115](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17115) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- Anthropic composer predictions now cache the persisted conversation prefix; `/btw` follow-ups reuse stable topic history without caching regenerated image descriptions ([#17186](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17186))
- Fixed `wait` returning a skipped-tool error for background completions, peer messages, or parent steering queued before execution ([#17174](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17174) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))
- Session-stop extensions now pass all continuation messages to the agent instead of silently discarding every message after the first; blocking decisions still take priority ([#17129](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17129) by [@aktanazat](https://github.com/aktanazat))
- Fixed the crash and SIGTERM recovery hint offering `omp --resume <id>` for a session that was never saved to disk, which `--resume` cannot load; such a session now prints no resume command ([#17119](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17119) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- Fixed Ctrl+V over SSH pasting the server's clipboard when the client terminal forwards the key instead of pasting (e.g. Tern on Windows into a macOS host); omp now leaves the remote clipboard alone and points you to your terminal's paste shortcut ([#17149](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17149) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Fixed `apply_patch` committing unmatched old/context text or dropping numeric prefixes; matching now uses complete lines without changing other edit modes' fuzzy behavior ([#17184](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17184) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))
- Fixed context-free `apply_patch` line deletions leaving blank rows, including first, last and only lines ([#17184](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17184) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))
- Fixed `apply_patch` rejecting move-only updates and move-then-add envelopes; moves preserve source bytes and permissions and later sections see the ordered file state ([#17184](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17184) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))
- Fixed `omp plugin` commands applying changes under `--dry-run`: `upgrade` and `omp update --plugins --check` now preview, and actions without a preview reject the flag ([#17104](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17104) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- Turning off `async.widgets` mid-session now stops spec requests for already-shown job widgets and aborts any request in flight ([#17090](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17090) by [@yuzu-octopus](https://github.com/yuzu-octopus))
- Fixed `learn` not hot-registering a newly minted or updated managed skill in the active session (`session.skills`, `skill://`, and the system prompt), and fixed `composeRecallQuery` dropping prior user turns when an earlier turn repeated the latest prompt ([#17113](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17113) by [@GTanger](https://github.com/GTanger))
- Fixed `@path` file mentions skipping `.pdf`, `.docx`, `.xlsx`, `.pptx`, and `.epub` files as binary instead of converting them to Markdown with `markit` like CLI `@file` arguments and `read` ([#17193](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17193) by [@GTanger](https://github.com/GTanger))
- Fixed an automatic retry fallback (a hop down `retry.fallbackChains` or the Fireworks Fast degrade) re-rendering the system prompt for the new model, which made Anthropic write the whole cached conversation again on each hop; a hop now keeps the Model line and Delegation wording, and rebuilds only when the new model needs a different edit mode, tool-description handling, or tool set ([#17014](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17014) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- Fixed a live subagent's system prompt re-rendering its peer list, with each peer's current activity, on every rebuild, which made Anthropic write the whole cached conversation again; the list now updates only when a rebuild changes the rest of the prompt, and `history://` lists the current peers ([#17014](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17014) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- SQLite row selectors now avoid shadowed ROWID aliases so reads, updates, and deletes target the intended single row. ([#16998](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16998), [#17001](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17001) by [@ai-yang](https://github.com/ai-yang))
- Fixed composer predictions offering notes relayed in from other agents or sessions (for example an orchestrator's pasted status note) as the user's next message; predictions now cover only what the person at the keyboard would type ([#17185](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17185) by [@wolfiesch](https://github.com/wolfiesch))
- Fixed image descriptions using the first vision model in catalog order (such as `claude-fable-5`) when no vision model is configured; they now use the least expensive priced vision-capable model ([#17148](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17148), [#17196](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17196) by [@gcp](https://github.com/gcp))
- Fixed `wait` results and background job deliveries naming a finished subagent only by a job id that differs from its agent id (e.g. `Foo-2` for a messaged agent's new turn), where `agent://Foo-2` and `history://Foo-2` are not found; they now name `history://Foo`, plus `agent://Foo` when that turn published its output ([#17112](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17112) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- Fixed `RpcClient.promptAndWait()` hanging until its timeout when the agent process exits or the client stops after the prompt was acknowledged; it now rejects right away ([#17135](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17135) by [@andrebrait](https://github.com/andrebrait))
- Fixed reading versioned Read the Docs pages serving the development branch's source file instead of the requested version's content when the page's Edit link targets another branch ([#17091](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17091) by [@yuzu-octopus](https://github.com/yuzu-octopus))
- Fixed RPC startup hanging when an extension opens a dialog during `session_start`: the client can now answer it, and other commands still wait for startup to finish, in order ([#17139](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17139) by [@andrebrait](https://github.com/andrebrait))
- Fixed extension tools disappearing once the startup plan mode (`plan.defaultOnStartup`) was paused or its plan approved: tools of extensions that load after startup now stay, while built-ins that plan mode registered, such as its `write` transport, still go ([#17085](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17085) by [@appboypov](https://github.com/appboypov))
- Fixed a batch `task` call silently ignoring a `model` (or `sourceSession`) on a non-`seance` item while the `seance` agent is hidden, so the child ran on its own model; the call is now refused with the same error as a single-agent call ([#17107](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17107) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- Fixed an edit under an older `[path#TAG]` header, after another edit had changed the file, applying to lines that read never displayed, including a line it had cut at the column cap; such an edit now shows the anchored lines first, as it does under the file's current tag ([#16208](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16208), [#17033](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17033) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- Fixed `omp gc --compress` (and the `gc.autoCompress` background run) taking minutes on large session histories ([#17195](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17195) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Fixed `omp gc --compress --apply` spending time on every idle session where the filesystem does not actually compress files (e.g. macOS 27); it now reports `compress skipped: <reason>`, and `gc.autoCompress` no longer slows interactive startup with that check ([#17195](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17195) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
