### Fixed

- Fixed local embeddings using one spinning CPU thread per core, so a single recall query cost several CPU-seconds on a many-core machine ([#17109](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17109) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-natives

### Added

- Added opt-in, cycle-safe descendant-link traversal to native `glob` through `followLinks`, leaving default traversal unchanged ([#17180](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17180) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))

### Changed

- Faster native line, word, and structured patch diffs on large edits ([#17015](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17015) by [@GTanger](https://github.com/GTanger))

### Fixed

- Fixed the built-in `sort` using many times its `-S` buffer size, or more memory than its container allows or the machine has available, on inputs of short lines, and ignoring `timeout` or a cancel while it sorts ([#17155](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17155) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- Fixed the built-in `sort -m` and `sort -c` splitting lines longer than their read buffer, and `sort` joining a file's unterminated last line to the next file's first line ([#17155](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17155) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- Fixed the built-in `sort -S N%` using the wrong buffer size: `-S 50%` gave 0 bytes and `-S 100%` a thousand times the machine's memory; it is now N percent of physical memory as in GNU sort ([#17155](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17155) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- Exited bash-tool `&` jobs are reaped without another command; `wait` still reports their status, and `$!` works inside pipelines, subshells, and command substitutions ([#17144](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17144)).
- On macOS, the bash tool's built-in `ps` includes other users' processes and unreaped zombies when selecting a PID ([#17144](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17144)).
- Fixed native `glob` file-type filters discarding target size and modification time for linked files ([#17180](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17180) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))
- Fixed leading UTF-8 BOMs causing embedded `jq` JSON input parse errors while preserving raw-input bytes ([#17179](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17179) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))
- Fixed the shell's `timeout` and tool aborts not stopping built-in commands that were still reading (`cat /dev/zero`, huge files, FIFOs with no writer) ([#17141](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17141) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- Fixed a tool abort leaving a background in-process command, such as `cat /dev/zero > /dev/null &`, running and keeping a core busy after its shell session was gone ([#17141](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17141) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- Fixed a shell redirect to or from a FIFO whose other end is a background job, such as `echo hi > f & cat < f`, hanging the command; a tool abort now also stops a write redirect to a FIFO that has no reader ([#17141](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17141) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- Fixed a background external command with a FIFO redirect, such as `/bin/cat < f & echo hi > f`, hanging the shell until the FIFO's other end opened; the command's own process now opens it, as in bash ([#17141](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17141) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- Fixed `timeout` printing `error: interrupted` when its limit stopped a built-in command; like GNU `timeout`, it now prints nothing of its own and exits 124 ([#17141](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17141) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- Fixed crackling in live voice playback: the assistant's speech now absorbs packet jitter without dropping out, short turns play without waiting for the next response, and lost packets no longer insert extra synthesized audio ([#17114](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17114))
- Fixed the bash tool's `rm -r` and `du` crashing the whole session with a stack overflow on a directory tree thousands of levels deep; `rm -r` also removes such a tree without running out of file descriptors, and reports a directory that is its own ancestor instead of descending into it ([#17021](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17021) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- Fixed the bash tool's `find` panicking and writing a native panic report to `~/.omp/logs` when the command reading its output exits early, as in `find . -printf '%p\n' | head -1`, or when its stderr is closed; it now stops quietly, and a failed `-fprintf` write is reported instead of `find: internal error` ([#17079](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17079) by [@trukhinyuri](https://github.com/trukhinyuri))
- Fixed the shell's built-in `grep` and `rg` running the whole agent out of memory on a file with no line breaks, such as a large sparse file: a line over 256 MiB is now reported as `not searched` for that file and the search continues, and a `-f` pattern file over 256 MiB is refused with exit status 2 ([#17108](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17108) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- Fixed the embedded shell's globs keeping matches whose literal tail does not exist: `ls -d DIR/*/` now lists only directories instead of passing every file as `file/`, and `*/name` keeps only matches that contain `name`, as in bash ([#17110](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17110) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- Fixed the embedded shell ignoring `shopt -s globstar`: `**` now matches any number of directory levels as in bash (`**/*.rs` finds files at every depth, also in `compgen -G`), and a timeout or interrupt stops a long `**` expansion ([#17111](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17111) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Added

- Added a frame-write listener (`TUI.addFrameWriteListener`) for terminal integrations that need to react to emitted ANSI output, including resize paints ([#17145](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17145))
- `HookInputComponent` (`showHookInput`) now accepts `{ secret: true }` to mask typed characters as bullets (`•`) in input overlays ([#17080](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17080) by [@GTanger](https://github.com/GTanger))
- Added an ANSI and native `/context` viewer with category navigation, content inspection, token-usage and compaction estimates, and keyboard/mouse controls that adapt across Tern and other terminals ([#16160](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16160) by [@C-W-Z](https://github.com/C-W-Z)).

### Fixed

- Fixed `AskDialogComponent`'s draft input guard holding the keyboard until the draft was cleared; Up/Down (or a pointer action) now release it so the question can be answered with the draft parked, and `syncPresentation` receives the effective blocked state ([#17215](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17215) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Fixed the prompt editor's autocomplete popup (e.g. emoji suggestions after `:D`) staying open and following the cursor after Shift/Ctrl/Alt+Enter inserted a newline, so the next Enter submitted past a stale list; newlines and cursor motion (arrows, Home/End, word jumps, character jumps) now close it ([#17215](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17215) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Fixed `run_watch` failed-job rows hiding why a job's logs are unavailable; multiline `gh` errors now stay on one row ([#17173](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17173) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))

### Removed

- Removed the static context usage report (`ContextUsageView`, `renderContextUsage`, `describeContextUsage`), `contextUsageHead()`, and the `glyph` and `color` fields of `ContextBreakdown` categories; use `ContextViewer` ([#16160](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16160) by [@C-W-Z](https://github.com/C-W-Z)).
- Fixed Markdown tables inside list items disappearing from the terminal transcript ([#17165](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17165)).

## @oh-my-pi/pi-utils

### Added

- Added `deadlineMs` and `waitMessage` cleanup registration options: shutdown waits longer for that callback, but only while it is still pending, and says so on stderr once nothing else is left to wait for ([#17128](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17128) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- A process stopped by SIGTERM now prints its registered recovery commands after the terminal is handed back, so a stopped omp session shows `omp --resume <id>` instead of leaving its last frame above the shell prompt like a crash ([#17119](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17119) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))

### Fixed

- Fixed plain TAR archives requiring a whole-container memory buffer to list entries or read a selected member ([#17175](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17175) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))

name: Chromium v155.0.8059.39.2 — Stealth Build (Pro)
body:
## CloakBrowser Pro: Linux Stable advances to Chromium 155.0.8059.39.2

Chromium `155.0.8059.39.2` is now Stable on **Linux** (x64 and ARM64). Windows and macOS Stable stay on `155.0.8059.39.1`.

With a valid CloakBrowser key, the wrapper automatically selects the Stable build for your platform. No version pin is required.

### What's new since 155.0.8059.39.1 (Linux)

- **A more resilient license connection.** Launch and close now ride out brief network or server hiccups by retrying, and startup is a bit quicker. Seats are also released more reliably when you close the browser.
- **Request interception that holds up.** Using `page.route` or other request interception no longer randomly crashes Chrome's network process.
- **More Windows fonts.** Windows personas on Linux now include more app fonts, plus language-pack fonts that follow the locale. A fixed Windows seed will report more fonts than before.
- **Audio at the right speed.** Web Audio now plays at the correct speed on 44.1 kHz and 96 kHz audio devices, and a page's own sample rate is respected.
- **Closer to real Chrome.** The reported window position stays inside the screen's work area, a short GPU vendor flag such as `intel` reports the full vendor name, and one more popular fingerprint test now passes.
- **Google is the default search engine again** when you use the browser directly. Choose another with `--fingerprint-search-engine=google|bing|duckduckgo|none`, or pass your own search URL.

Your profiles, cookies, and seeds are untouched. Only the browser itself is replaced.

### Current wrapper: v0.6.4

Update the wrapper before launching:

```bash
pip install -U cloakbrowser
npm update cloakbrowser
dotnet add package CloakBrowser --version 0.6.4
```

### Roll back if needed

If a workload regresses, pin the previous Linux Stable build:

```bash
export CLOAKBROWSER_VERSION=155.0.8059.39.1
```

Remove the pin to return to the newest Stable build.

**If you hit a regression, please tell us.** [Open an issue](https://github.com/CloakHQ/CloakBrowser/issues) or email support@cloakbrowser.dev with the site and what you saw. Pinning the old build gets you unblocked; a report gets it fixed for everyone.

### Checksums (SHA-256)

```text
version=155.0.8059.39.2
d54521088fd2ca0a6584c490c7ce43d02d6e1190013a759517632d9b7d0a1c0d  cloakbrowser-linux-x64.tar.gz
f9a2e4666de97f98e3bfdb5d96f9c3c32ae2aa09573b811226a3ddbad1f08430  cloakbrowser-linux-arm64.tar.gz
```

The signed manifest (`SHA256SUMS` and `SHA256SUMS.sig`) is attached. The wrapper verifies its Ed25519 signature and each archive's SHA-256 checksum automatically.

name: Reasonix Studio v2.54.0
body:
本版新增全局显示 / 隐藏快捷键、用量页的上传量、隐藏服务商共同前缀，并把设置拆成子页、壁纸移到外观，修复多处预算与界面问题。

## 新增

- 桌面设置提供默认关闭的全局显示 / 隐藏快捷键，支持按键录制与清除；仅 Studio 运行时有效，不会启动已退出的应用。关联 #8290 fixed in #14592 by @lancy69。
- 服务商设置里可以「隐藏共同前缀」，路由类服务给每个模型加的同一段前缀（如 group/）在各处显示时省略，只改显示。关联 #14573 fixed in #14578。
- 设置 → 用量里多了「上传量」，显示今天和近 30 天发给模型服务商的请求内容大小、次数、平均每次多大，并按服务商列出。关联 #14670。
- 反馈窗口会记住上一次成功提交的联系方式并自动填入，仍可修改，清空后不会再冒出旧的。关联 #14610 fixed in #14666 by @lancy69。
- 主题可以按深色 / 浅色分别设置导航、图标栏、顶栏、侧栏和输入框在背景图上的不透明度。关联 #14589 by @lancy69。
- 新增默认关闭的「连接检测」授权开关，只有你打开后才会向服务商发起后台检测请求。关联 #14620 by @SivanCola。

## 变更

- 设置里「模型偏好」的「看图」下拉框只列出已声明支持读图的模型；已选的旧模型仍会显示，并标明"未声明读图"。关联 #14418 fixed in #14420 and #14597。
- 「壁纸」及其选择、替换、移除、导入、浓度、压暗和焦点控件移到「外观」的独立区块，已选壁纸的预览直接显示。关联 #14470 fixed in #14588 by @lancy69。
- 待发送队列与输入框共用外框和底色，采用紧凑透明行与轻量图标操作；现有操作与快捷键保持不变。关联 #14497 fixed in #14591 by @lancy69。
- 较长的「工具与权限」和「外观」拆成几个子页，在左侧导航里直接点选；搜索或链接会自动切到设置所在的子页。关联 #14625。
- 设置页文字统一成同一套样式，字号从 10 种减到 5 种，字重和灰色也收成固定几档。关联 #14625。
- 关闭工作台里最后一个页面后，留下"新建页面"的启动器，不再把整列收起。关联 #14037 by @imcreazy。
- 「柔和」对比度改为真正更低对比、仍达 AA 的内置配色，不再比默认更强。关联 #12019 fixed in #14590 by @lancy69。

## 修复

- 打开设置时不再每次遍历磁盘统计「存储」大小；这个数字延后读取，十分钟内沿用上次结果。关联 #14315 fixed in #14650。
- 用量总额会说明其中有几笔调用未定价、以及原因，不再只由一个标志暗示。关联 #14522 by @chuiwenwei。
- 压缩上下文时摘要请求的连接被中途重置（比如本地网关重启），会自动重试一次，不再直接失败。关联 #14643 fixed in #14648。
- 压缩后“较早的消息过长，只通过摘要保留”的提示在中文界面下也用中文显示。修复 #14651 fixed in #14664。
- 命令或同一批调用被宿主拦截时，工具卡片用中文说明原因，不再显示英文的 blocked 提示。修复 #14652 fixed in #14655。
- 历史超过读取上限的会话不再只报英文错误，会说明文件完好，并可「从最近的内容继续」另存为新会话。修复 #14660 fixed in #14662。
- 删除来自 Reasonix 1.x 的会话后，同一会话不再重新出现在侧栏；删除状态重启后保留，且不修改 1.x 的原始存储。修复 #14632 fixed in #14657 by @lancy69。
- 在弹窗里放大查看截图时，按 Esc 只退出大图，不再关掉整个反馈弹窗。修复 #14609 fixed in #14612。
- 点“继续派发”后，输入框上方“待发送已暂停”的提示会随之消失。修复 #14616 fixed in #14618。
- 鼠标点开设置等弹窗后按 Esc 关闭，左侧图标栏按钮不再带着焦点环停在“悬停”样子。关联 #14624。
- 工作区里有多个 Git 仓库时，改动列表不再撑出面板，有自己的滚动条。修复 #14628 fixed in #14630。
- 文件工具栏的保存按钮保持紧凑，启用和禁用状态都清晰可读。关联 #14231。
- 同一个网关拒绝 stream_options 的结论按进程只学一次，不再让每个新会话都多发一次失败请求。关联 #14606。
- 显式子代理技能调用遵守已有任务根预算；恢复 Goal 时规划与执行一起获得新的预算切片；本地费用门禁采用发生时刻的权威报价；Windows 跟踪命令保留已发布的 Job Object owner。关联 #14025。
- 文件大小和修改时间未变时，候选快照不再复用 Git 缓存中的旧内容，私有索引重建保留用户暂存区。关联 #14025。
- ACP 的 inbox 拒绝带机器码：`-32020` 队列拒绝，`-32021` 该工作可能已执行、不要重试。关联 #14551 by @chuiwenwei。

## 贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@lancy69、@SivanCola、@imcreazy、@chuiwenwei

<!-- lang:en -->

## New

- An opt-in global show/hide shortcut in desktop settings, with key recording and Clear; it works only while Studio runs and never launches a stopped app. Refs #8290 fixed in #14592 by @lancy69.
- A provider can hide the prefix all its models share (such as group/ from a router) everywhere the model name is drawn; display only. Refs #14573 fixed in #14578.
- Settings → Usage has "Upload volume": request bodies sent to model providers today and over 30 days, count, average size, and a per-provider list. Refs #14670.
- The feedback form remembers the last successfully submitted contact and prefills it; it stays editable and a cleared field stays cleared. Refs #14610 fixed in #14666 by @lancy69.
- Themes can set per-scheme (dark / light) opacity for the navigation, rail, chrome, side and composer surfaces over a background image. Refs #14589 by @lancy69.
- A default-off connection-health consent setting: background provider checks run only after you turn it on. Refs #14620 by @SivanCola.

## Changed

- The vision row in Model preferences lists only models declared to read images; a model chosen earlier stays visible, marked as not declared. Refs #14418 fixed in #14420 and #14597.
- Wallpaper, choose/change/remove, import, strength, dim and focus move to Appearance; the selected preview is visible directly. Refs #14470 fixed in #14588 by @lancy69.
- Pending messages share the composer frame, with compact transparent rows and icon actions; existing queue actions and shortcuts are unchanged. Refs #14497 fixed in #14591 by @lancy69.
- The long Tools & permissions and Appearance sections are split into pages in the left navigation; search and links open the page a setting is on. Refs #14625.
- Settings text follows one set of styles: 5 font sizes instead of 10, with fixed weights and grey tones. Refs #14625.
- Closing the last page in the workbench leaves the new-page launcher instead of folding the column away. Refs #14037 by @imcreazy.
- The Soft contrast level is a genuinely lower-contrast built-in palette that still meets AA, instead of reading stronger than the default. Refs #12019 fixed in #14590 by @lancy69.

## Fixed

- Opening Settings no longer walks the disk for the Storage total each time; it is read after the window is up and reused for ten minutes. Refs #14315 fixed in #14650.
- A usage total says how many of its calls were never priced, and why, instead of only carrying an incomplete flag. Refs #14522 by @chuiwenwei.
- When the connection of a context-summary request is reset mid-stream, compaction retries once instead of failing at once. Refs #14643 fixed in #14648.
- The "earlier messages were too large to keep whole" notice after a compaction reads in the window's language. Fixes #14651 fixed in #14664.
- When the host stops a command or a call in a batch before it runs, the tool card explains why in your language instead of an English "blocked:" line. Fixes #14652 fixed in #14655.
- A session over the read limit no longer stops at an English error; the file stays intact and "Continue from the most recent part" saves its newest part as a new session. Fixes #14660 fixed in #14662.
- Deleted 1.x conversations stay out of the sidebar after restart; the original store stays unchanged. Fixes #14632 fixed in #14657 by @lancy69.
- Pressing Esc on an enlarged screenshot closes only the screenshot instead of the whole feedback dialog. Fixes #14609 fixed in #14612.
- The "queue paused" notice goes away once dispatch resumes instead of lingering. Fixes #14616 fixed in #14618.
- After a mouse-opened dialog is closed with Esc, the icon rail button no longer keeps a focus ring as if hovered. Refs #14624.
- With several Git repositories in a workspace, the workbench changes list no longer grows past the panel; it scrolls on its own. Fixes #14628 fixed in #14630.
- The file toolbar's Save button stays compact and readable in both enabled and disabled states. Refs #14231.
- An endpoint's refusal of stream_options is learned once per process, so each new session no longer sends one extra failing request. Refs #14606.
- Explicit subagent skills share the existing root budget, and resuming a Goal renews planner and executor budget together. Refs #14025.
- Local cost gates use the occurrence-time quote, and tracked Windows commands keep their published Job Object owner. Refs #14025.
- Candidate snapshots no longer reuse stale Git-cached content when size and mtime are unchanged, and private index rebuilds keep the user's staging area. Refs #14025.
- ACP inbox refusals carry machine codes: `-32020` for a queue refusal, `-32021` for work that may already have run and must not be retried. Refs #14551 by @chuiwenwei.

# oh-my-codex v0.21.38

`0.21.38` is a patch release that makes setup refresh self-heal stale trust records for OMX-owned plugin hooks after a plugin cache rebuild.

name: v2.13.7 — Fixes contradictions and stale facts found while rewriting marketing-skills.com's skill p…
body:
Fixes contradictions and stale facts found while rewriting marketing-skills.com's skill pages:

- **ab-testing** (2.0.2 → 2.0.3): sample-size tables recomputed. The reference ran about 2.3× high (31,000 per variant for 3% → 3.6%) and SKILL.md about 10–20% low (12k); both now come from the two-proportion formula at α 0.05 two-sided, 80% power (14k), with the assumptions stated.
- **cold-email** (2.2.0 → 2.2.1): follow-up reply share aligned with the sourced Instantly 2026 benchmark (~58% of replies from email 1, ~42% from follow-ups) instead of an unsourced 55%.
- **revops** (2.2.1 → 2.2.2): MQL thresholds tied to their own example point tables (the two references used different weights), and SLA recipes reassign leads only under an agreed reassignment rule, matching inbound-routing.
- **paywalls** (2.1.0 → 2.1.1) and **offers** (1.0.2 → 1.0.3): paywall discount experiments now reward commitment and real deadlines (offers rules out acquisition discounts and fake scarcity); fake countdowns join the dark-patterns list; annual-prepay pricing is distinguished from acquisition discounts.
- **image** (2.0.2 → 2.0.3): current Black Forest Labs names (FLUX 3 Image; FLUX.2 [pro]/[flex]/[dev]/[klein]; FLUX.1 Kontext as previous generation), Midjourney V7 throughout, and an unsourced "#1 page speed killer" line removed. OpenAI's gpt-image-2.5 names checked against its deprecations page.
- **directory-submissions** (2.1.3 → 2.1.4): G2's deal for Capterra, GetApp, and Software Advice dated to its Jan 2026 announcement, with Software Advice no longer called a Gartner property; "AI engines penalize duplicate content" (unsourced) replaced, eval updated; a dated G2 price removed.
- **aso** (2.0.2 → 2.0.3): the screenshot rubric weights the first three screens instead of rewarding 8–10 (benchmarks say returns diminish past 6); the +2.5pp CPP figure is labelled as the organic-referral lift, distinct from the +5.9% average.
- **analytics** (2.2.1 → 2.2.2): gtag samples send GA4's recommended `sign_up` event, mapped from the internal `signup_completed`.
- **programmatic-seo** (2.1.0 → 2.1.1): subfolder advice rests on internal links, not a claim that subdomains split authority (its platforms reference says Google ranks neither higher); "Stats" removed from the playbook table.
- **content-strategy** (2.1.4 → 2.1.5): the scoring example totals 7.9, not 8.0. **community-marketing** (2.0.1 → 2.0.2): "5 community models" described four. **copywriting** (2.3.1 → 2.3.2): clarity figures credited to Founding Marketing, Ch. 3. **customer-research** (2.0.4 → 2.0.5): one persona minimum. **copy-editing** (2.2.0 → 2.2.1): its approved example dropped an em dash its own check bans. **popups** (2.0.0 → 2.0.1) and **lead-magnets** (2.1.0 → 2.1.1): duplicate related-skill entries merged.

name: Sub2API 0.2.19
body:
> AI API Gateway Platform - 将 AI 订阅配额分发和管理

新增按操作与资源范围授权的管理员 API Key；OpenAI / Composite 分组支持按实际出图张数计费，并新增 GPT-6.1 Terra 模型支持。

## 新增功能

- 管理员 API Key：可按操作和资源范围授权，支持过期时间和 IP 白名单；只保存不可逆摘要，撤销记录保留用于审计
- 按张计费：OpenAI 和 Composite 分组新增「按张计费」开关（默认关闭），一次生成多张图时按上游实际返回的张数计费，只对专用图片端点生效
- OpenAI：支持 GPT-6.1 Terra 模型
- Gemini：同账号重试次数可通过 gateway.max_same_account_retries_gemini 配置（默认 4，范围 0–10）
- Grok：管理端新增账号模型目录诊断，可查看来源、可信状态和与本地映射的差异；手动同步和后台观察统一使用同一套解析规则

## 优化改进

- Gemini：刷新默认模型列表，移除已停用的 2.0/2.5 系列和 3-pro-preview；连接测试默认模型改为 gemini-3.5-flash
- Gemini：分组内账号都配置了模型映射时，/v1beta/models 列表和详情按声明的模型返回，与 /v1/models 口径一致
- Gemini：绑定显式缓存的请求在池模式上游网关账号上，按配置在同一账号重试
- 国产 Coding Plan 账号遇到请求频率型 429 时改为秒级冷却，不再停调到 5h 窗口结束
- 模型列表刷新在并发冷启动时不再重复请求上游
- Grok：原生 Responses 和各转换路径都会记录上游原始响应模型，便于审计

## Bug 修复

- 修复 Gemini 以 fileData 形式返回的图片未计费的问题
- 修复渠道按次计费的图片档位丢失 token 用量的问题
- 修复 DeepSeek V4 Pro 在 9 月 14 日之后定价失效的问题
- 修复 DeepSeek prompt_cache_hit_tokens 未计为缓存读取的问题
- 修复 OpenCode 转发 DeepSeek 时 developer 角色导致 422 的问题
- 修复 Antigravity 非流式畸形工具调用返回空成功响应的问题
- 修复超大 multipart 图片上传被静默截断的问题，现在直接拒绝
- 修复分页参数过大时偏移量溢出导致 500 的问题
- 修复管理员保护规则校验返回 500 的问题，现返回 400
- 修复保存渠道时覆盖 web_search_emulation 平台维度的问题
- 修复模型广场分组模型定价被图片兜底档位覆盖的问题
- 修复 Grok 模型目录快照被失败请求、乱序请求或旧表单覆盖的问题

## 升级指南

- 本版本包含数据库迁移 247（scoped_admin_api_keys 表）和 248（groups.image_count_billing 列），启动时会自动执行
- Gemini 默认模型列表已移除 2.x 系列；仍需使用这些模型的账号请自行在白名单或模型映射中配置



---

## 📥 Installation

**Docker:**
```bash
# Docker Hub
docker pull weishaw/sub2api:0.2.19

# GitHub Container Registry
docker pull ghcr.io/wei-shaw/sub2api:0.2.19
```

**One-line install (Linux):**
```bash
curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Wei-Shaw/sub2api/main/deploy/install.sh | sudo bash
```

**Manual download:**
Download the appropriate archive for your platform from the assets below.

## 📚 Documentation

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Wei-Shaw/sub2api)
- [Installation Guide](https://github.com/Wei-Shaw/sub2api/blob/main/deploy/README.md)

name: v0.40.0
body:
### Breaking Changes

- **`@agent-browser/eve` now requires eve 0.84.0 or later.** eve 0.84.0 rejects extensions built by earlier releases, so the extension is now built with it. Apps on older eve should stay on `@agent-browser/eve@0.39` (#2226)

### New Features

- Added **one MCP server per Vercel Sandbox** with `startAgentBrowserMcp` in `@agent-browser/sandbox/vercel`, which keeps a single `agent-browser mcp` running over Sandbox stdin, and `connectAgentBrowserMcp` for any runtime that exposes stdin and stdout streams (#2228)
- Added **`--omit-command`** to `batch` and `omitCommand` to the MCP batch tool, replacing repeated raw command arrays in JSON output with zero-based indexes (#2216)

### Bug Fixes

- Fixed **`state load` and launch-time storage restores** exposing saved tokens to page scripts and writing one origin's storage into another after a redirect; storage is now written through DevTools only while the page is on the saved origin, and skipped origins are reported (#2212)
- Fixed **`<session>.config` files** piling up in the socket directory after daemons exit (#2128)
- Fixed **mocked cross-origin responses** failing CORS: `network route --body` now takes `--allow-origin <origin>` (also in the MCP `network_route` tool) to answer preflights and send CORS headers to that origin, and sends a JSON body as `application/json` when no content type is set (#2229)
- Fixed **Windows sessions** where a dead daemon could keep holding a pinned tab, and where two sessions with the same name in different socket directories could connect to each other's daemon (#2223)

### Contributors

- @OwenKephart
- @Railly
- @lahfir
- @hichipli
- @jomatsu

name: v15.4.0
body:
## My Work: focus areas, and requests that file themselves

### Focus areas are the top level of My Work (#5131)
- **MY FOCUS rail.** Your focus areas are listed in priority order, with a needs-you count on each. Every request sits in exactly one area, or in **Other**. On phones the areas appear as a chip row.
- **Area header.** Each area page shows its goal sentence, combined progress, your own quotes, the asks you haven't started yet, and a link to Past focus. The My Goals page is retired; its content now lives here.
- **Suggested.** New areas appear here by themselves. You can Keep, Rename, Merge or Dismiss each one, with Undo. Your decisions sync across computers and a refresh never overrides them.
- **Owner-goals sorts what it mines.** It applies three tests in order, so each statement becomes exactly one focus area, ask or rule. Priorities and open asks no longer duplicate each other.
- **The Focus step replaces Align in the automatic refresh.** It places every request, and it proposes new areas from Other or from a request that holds several separate asks.
- **Request cards.** Every card shows its area, and request detail has **Move to…**. "What came out of it" is now called **Deliverables**.

### The judge files new conversations under their request (#5110)
- **Before any grouping agent runs,** each new conversation is filed: a code link (the same work-state list or `request_id`) joins at once. On CMEM Pro, or with your own OpenRouter key, Jev also checks whether the conversation continues one of your open requests. At a check score of 0.8 or more it joins. Between 0.5 and 0.8 you get a **Join / Not this** suggestion on the card. Otherwise it starts its own request.
- **Focus areas too.** On the same installs, Jev suggests a focus area for each request before the Focus step runs. The pick is only a hint to the Focus agent for now: automatic placement waits until enough of your own moves exist to calibrate a cutoff.
- **Without Jev,** everything works as before.

### A request keeps its conversations across project roots (#5106)
- A request whose decision names its project root keeps conversations from other roots, and later refreshes can still add to it.

### Fixes
- The sync-api query-plan test applies its own schema, so it no longer fails depending on test order.

**CMEM Pro:** the Jev decisions gateway (`/api/inference/v1/decisions`) is live for Pro subscribers.

Search 功能优先向模型提供 Search API 长摘要，默认每来源最多 800 字符；搜索卡片仍展示短摘录。 @yudshj - 模型选择器默认勾选已配置模型，可一次添加或移除候选并保留自定义值；筛选后的全选只作用于可见候选。 @turtle2099 - 对通过 pi-ai 接入且不支持在对话中追加系统消息的模型，后续系统消息会在原位置作为提醒提供，不会移到最初的提示词中。 @Tuyixiang - 系统提示词未变化时，新一轮模型请求可继续复用已有上下文前缀缓存，避免不必要的缓存失效。 @mektpoy - 缺少所需凭据时不向模型提供 Web 搜索工具；新版 Web API 的抓取工具也按凭据就绪状态提供。 @LegGasai - 修复关闭应用时 Auto 会话权限意外变成完全访问的问题，保留已保存的权限与审批策略。 @tianyicui - 等待后台任务输出时，用户插话可立即解除等待并返回当前输出，后台任务继续运行。 @mektpoy - 修复预设往返切换后委派工具暂时缺失的问题，并让委派工具遵循当前 Agent 的工具限制。 @Dudu-0223 - 被阻塞的目标可从 Web 目标栏继续；已耗尽轮次上限时仍需先提高上限。 @turtle2099 - `sdk-minimal` 配置在请求模型或执行工具前保存会话恢复记录；保存失败时不会继续相关操作，提高短会话中断后的可恢复性。 @LogosVeritas - 本地文件工具将开头的 ~ 或 ~/ 正确展开为宿主主目录，路径中间的 ~ 保持字面含义。 @turtle2099 - 修复多选问题有多个推荐选项时只预选第一项的问题，现在卡片打开时预选全部推荐项；单选和已回答卡片的行为保持不变。 @yudshj - 聊天中的相对文件链接按点击时会话当前工作目录打开，进入 worktree 后不再误开原项目文件。 @turtle2099 - Markdown 中单个 ~ 保持字面显示，只有 ~~ 才形成删除线。 @turtle2099 - 修复跨行 $$ 数学块的渲染，保留首行公式内容及公式后的正文。 @Chinesezjc - 本地 Markdown 图片被覆盖后，新消息和新打开的预览会显示当前文件，而不是复用旧图。 @turtle2099 - 修复裸 URL 将后续中文标点及正文一并识别为链接的问题 @turtle2099 - 修复 Markdown 中 Windows 文件路径的反斜杠被转义删除，导致链接或图片打开错误位置的问题。 @turtle2099 - 交付卡与收尾回复中的文件引用覆盖整轮，包括回复之后的交付与写入；present 说明等待用户回答前应先提供文件链接。 @yudshj - 修复部分结构体代码高亮导致页面长时间卡死的问题。 @yudshj - 修复输入框粘贴文件或文件夹路径时仅高亮目录前缀的问题。 @turtle2099 - 断线或重连期间暂停聊天运行计时，连接恢复后按轮次起点恢复显示。 @turtle2099 - 停止后补发的插话与新消息在轨迹中按日志顺序显示于助手输出之前，刷新和历史加载后仍保持一致。 @kermanx - 侧栏原生拖动使用独立主题背景预览，避免混入后方消息内容并保留排序。 @Stevring - 深色主题设置导航的悬停背景可见，选中态保持优先。 @turtle2099 - 长问题和选项说明可原地展开与收起，内容区滚动时导航与提交按钮保持可见。 @yudshj - 修复 macOS 激活窗口时点击会话标题误触发重命名，正常双击重命名保持不变。 @turtle2099 - 切换、打开或关闭侧栏文件标签时，标签栏从原滚动位置继续，不再先跳回最左端。 @turtle2099 - 普通会话分支现在独立运行，不再被误识别为子智能体；真正子智能体仍保留创建者关系。 @Dudu-0223 - 安装自托管 Git 插件时，HTTPS 无法读取而 SSH 可用时改用 SSH。 @turtle2099 - 安装含 prepare 脚本的 Git 插件时，显示脚本授权和重试选项，不再仅报告未知错误。 @turtle2099 - 审批提示明确说明是否向用户请求授权，避免模型误解 never 策略。 @turtle2099 - 修复 macOS 持久 Bash 工具中感叹号被历史展开改写或导致命令超时的问题。 @grllll - 明确告知模型：用户跳过提问后应继续，不重复追问，也不能把跳过当作授权。 @turtle2099 - 修复一个技能根目录读取失败导致其他目录中的技能也不可用的问题，保留可用技能并提示不完整的发现结果。 @Dudu-0223 - 配置项目按自身 ESM 规则解析插件依赖子路径、包内导入和自引用。 @shigma - Web Fetch 可读取编码声明混含 UTF-8 的可读页面。 @Dudu-0223 - 修复工具调用因无歧义的可选参数而失败的问题：grep 接受空 include。 @turtle1999 - 修复以管理员权限运行 DSH 或在 Windows Sandbox 中使用时，受限沙箱命令无法启动的问题；文件写入和删除限制保持不变。 @huoyaoyuan - Windows 已安装应用显示正确的发布者名称，卸载列表中的应用名称不再附带版本号。 @winewill - 改善 Windows 安装器进度页绘制、拖动与窗口激活表现，恢复系统最小化动画，并让标题按钮在原区域松开时触发。 @winewill - 桌面 Host 完成任务清理并确认关闭后立即退出，避免遗留事件循环句柄阻塞更新安装。 @turtle2099 - macOS 桌面更新在确认前等待退出全屏，安装失败后恢复工作区；退出全屏超时则保留任务并提示重试。 @winewill - 桌面更新提示改为窗内视图，后台结果更新不再抬升原生子窗口；更新提示随应用浅色或暗色主题显示。 @winewill - 修复 macOS 桌面端会话头部菜单与按钮之间出现过大空隙的问题。 @turtle2099 - 修复 macOS 原生目录选择框初次显示后灰显、目录无法点击的问题。 @EricMoin ### 其他变更 - DSH 的最低 Node.js 版本提高至 24.9；使用旧版 Node.js 的用户需先升级运行时。 @tianyicui - SDK 提供与 Web 模式一致的文件交付、问答、调度、技能和上下文能力，并支持问答回调与操作审批。 @koalazf99 - 修复会话创建、恢复和销毁期间的事件发布与清理顺序；初始化事件可实时订阅，取消时等待已取得资源完成清理。 @kermanx - Session API 新增独立接口，可分别读取快照和持续订阅会话事件日志、运行状态以及事件投影数据。 @imccyu - 自定义插件需迁移到异步会话投影句柄，旧注册释放函数与按 key 读取保留兼容和弃用提示；审批状态恢复要求组合提供 sessionProjections 并等待服务激活。 @kermanx, @Magolor - 整单元 JSON 与 SQLite 存储支持读取领域明确声明的兼容旧版本，并以新版本格式写入。 @Magolor - Web Fetch 不再拒绝非公网地址，可用于代理与内网，部署应自行限制网络访问。 @turtle2099 - Cordis Timer 实现同步上游，自定义插件需适配返回值 @shigma - Cordis Fiber 提供统一的原始配置、候选配置解析和生效配置访问，设置编辑与热更新使用一致的配置来源。 @shigma - 桌面启动故障可获取诊断报告，并附上有界的近期插件操作记录，便于排查问题。 @winewill - macOS Computer Use 新增系统与应用权限引导，支持长按并改善应用启动；应用授权可跨重启保留。 @CreatixChu, @koalazf99 - Headless 支持实验性 Auto 自动审核 @tianyicui - Ralph 循环与会话搜索继续随包分发，不再显示在实验性列表。 @ZiyaZhang - 升级 pi-ai 至 1.3.0，并同步模型目录、端点与推理回放规则；完整工具参数格式错误会在执行任何工具前终止该次响应。 @tianyicui - 未声明容量的自定义模型默认上下文与最大输出调整为十进制 1M/128K；较小端点应显式覆盖容量以避免延迟压缩。 @LegGasai - Agent 在提示词组装与 pre-step 前固定本步模型，重试保留同一选择；插件应通过 agent.model 选择模型，agent/request 不再允许改路由。 @kermanx - 「自定义插件市场」更名为「自定义插件索引」，发现页读取用户添加的索引文件，索引生成器排除标记为 private 的版本、标签与默认分支包。 @turtle2099, @turtle1999 - 官方组合包列表改由 @deepseek-ai/dsh-official-bundles 导出；自定义集成需更新原 app-boot 的相关导入。 @turtle2099 - 工具可按步骤条件启用，模型声明、PTC 绑定与执行准入保持一致；插件需迁移 tools.resolve/executable 与提示词组装接口。 @LegGasai - Node PTC 新增 VM Script 模式，支持顶层 await、动态导入和表达式结果，可独立开启跨调用状态保留；默认仍逐次执行，脚本顶层不支持 return 或 using。 @kermanx - 原生与 PTC 工具执行拆为按 Agent 作用域选择的插件；PTC 通过配置 overlay 启用，旧 tools.mode 与 DSH_TOOLS_MODE 需迁移。 @kermanx - PTC Node 控制通道改用 birpc；自部署 bootstrap 与 SSH helper 必须同步升级，SSH 协议从 2 升为 3。 @kermanx - PTC Mode 中由调用方取消的 run_code 改为返回 ABORTED，而非 CODE_RUN_FAILED；SDK 和 Session 消费方需更新取消分类。 @kermanx

New Features

- Show rich-text plugin details in the plugin manager and improve page layout and navigation. by @turtle1999, @turtle2099 - Support updating third-party plugin packages and attempt to restore the previous version if hot updates fail. by @turtle1999, @turtle2099 - Insert chat text as quotes in the composer and show compact previews after sending. by @lsdsjy, @imccyu - Copy the complete conversation history as Markdown, including the original log path when available. by @tianyicui - Keep all assistant text replies visible when work steps are collapsed, with an option to show only the final answer. by @imccyu - Add Japanese, Spanish, French, German, Russian, and Brazilian Portuguese interface text and locale configuration. by @07akioni - Clear all inactive automation tasks in one confirmed action while keeping active tasks. by @Chinesezjc - Add the experimental `subagent_oar` tool plugin to delegate independent tasks to local Codex or Claude CLIs. by @tianyicui - Add experimental Personalized recommendations, offering official-plugin activation or personalized-page creation cards below answers when relevant. by @ZiyaZhang - Add experimental Developer tools — Statistics for per-turn and per-step context, cache, model, and tool measurements. by @mektpoy - Add experimental Change requests and worktrees to run Sessions in separate Git worktrees and inspect linked PR status and code changes. by @LegGasai, @tianyicui ### Improvements - Improve mobile and tablet input with fewer automatic keyboard pop-ups, keyboard dismissal after sending, and corrected caret scrolling. by @Stevring - Use fullscreen settings with horizontal navigation on narrow browsers, scroll focused tabs fully into view, and use 16px task text fields on touch devices. by @Stevring - Keep touch actions free from hover tooltips, expose Workspace and archived-result controls, and scroll wide Markdown tables within their own containers. by @Stevring - Fade overflowing header status actions in narrow conversation panes so utility buttons such as Open in app remain visible and clickable. by @turtle2099 - Restore automatic icon-only model selection in narrow composers while retaining the full model name in the menu. by @LegGasai - Fix font settings crowding their labels and descriptions on phones and narrow windows by stacking font fields while keeping size controls right-aligned. by @EricMoin - Distinguish same-named Workspaces with their shortest unique path suffix and prioritize that suffix on narrow screens. by @turtle2099 - Use DPR-aware inset outlines on shared buttons to stabilize fine borders at fractional sizes in Safari without changing layout. by @Stevring - Place running status at the active turn tail before queued steering messages, distinguishing active and pending input and reducing layout jitter. by @imccyu - Support plugin icons in the Session list and improve keyboard and touch interaction. by @LegGasai - Show working directories on sidebar Session hover cards to distinguish ungrouped or similarly named Sessions. by @turtle2099 - Improve sidebar spacing and click targets, with smoother search-field expansion and collapse. by @Yifffan - Find Sessions by case-insensitive ID substrings in sidebar search. by @turtle2099 - Show messages and clear drafts only after the host accepts them. Keep the composer read-only while sending and preserve drafts, quotes, and attachments on failure. by @LegGasai - Upload images as soon as they enter the composer and reuse the uploaded images when sending messages. Raise the default per-image limit to 50 MiB. by @LegGasai - Show answered question batches as message bubbles so answers from native and PTC calls remain visible after work steps collapse. by @Kaige-Gao - Add resistance and spring-back when floating sidebar panels are dragged beyond screen edges, and keep their controls reachable when the window shrinks. by @yudshj - Close right-sidebar tabs with the middle mouse button without selecting background tabs, while preserving the protected start tab. by @Kingwl - Fix transcript jumps, scroll reversal, and blank gaps when expanding or folding work steps, while keeping running status visible. by @imccyu - Briefly highlight and fade the target line in code and text previews after opening a file-line link from chat. by @turtle2099 - Add raw JSON views of live tool results to Trajectory, displayed above rendered results. by @kermanx - Search prioritizes long Search API summaries for models, capped at 800 characters per source by default, while search cards retain short snippets. by @yudshj - Start the model picker with configured models selected, add or remove candidates while preserving custom values, and apply select-all only to visible candidates. by @turtle2099 - For models accessed through pi-ai that cannot accept additional system messages during a conversation, keep later system messages in place as reminders rather than moving them into the initial prompt. by @Tuyixiang - Reorder models within DeepSeek and pi-ai providers by dragging or using arrow keys, preserving order and complete model parameters when saved. by @Magolor - Show full truncated composer statistics in tooltips and include turn and step counts in Session statistics. by @turtle2099 - Improve history-context cache reuse across consecutive tool calls in Auto review to reduce repeated processing. by @turtle2099 - Background-job completion notices include small outputs and reduce duplicate notifications for already-read results and subagent closing messages. by @turtle1999 - Reduce sleeping and repeated polling in subagent guidance: end the current turn when only a result remains pending and wait for its completion notification. by @Chinesezjc - Enable WebSocket compression for remote connections by default to reduce transfers of large message histories; disable it with `websocketCompression`. by @imccyu - Web static assets support ETag revalidation, returning 304 for unchanged files to avoid repeated downloads. by @imccyu - Deliver ordinary Word edits after saving and checking content and formatting, without unnecessary ZIP, XML, or metadata inspection. by @tianyicui - Speed up first-time loading of lazy components such as the source editor in the Web preview. by @turtle2099 - Speed up file searches with literal directory prefixes by skipping unrelated directories while preserving results and ordering. by @kermanx - Pan images that exceed the viewport and transfer original files through in-app drag-and-drop or native desktop dragging. by @std4453 - Tell phone and tablet users when a file is opened on another device. Show failure notifications on all devices and keep successful desktop operations silent. by @Stevring ### Bug Fixes - Budget global and project AGENTS.md chains separately so project instructions do not evict global guidance; messages containing both chains can use up to twice maxBytes. by @ZiyaZhang - Compact history with the previous model before switching to a smaller context window; stop the switch request and preserve its previous header if compaction fails. by @Dudu-0223 - Preserve the required thought signatures in Gemini tool calls over OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions and include them in subsequent requests to prevent rejection caused by missing signatures. by @turtle2099 - Reuse existing context-prefix caches for new model requests when the system prompt is unchanged, avoiding unnecessary cache invalidation. by @mektpoy - Hide Web search tools when required credentials are missing; fetch tools using the newer Web API also follow credential readiness. by @LegGasai - Preserve saved Auto permission and approval policy during application shutdown instead of unintentionally switching to Full access. by @tianyicui - User steering now releases a background-output wait immediately and returns current output without stopping the job. by @mektpoy - Fix delegation tools being temporarily unavailable after preset round trips and apply the current Agent’s tool restrictions to delegation. by @Dudu-0223 - Resume blocked goals from the Web goal bar; goals that have exhausted their round limit still require a higher limit first. by @turtle2099 - Save Session recovery records before model requests and tool execution in `sdk-minimal`. Stop related operations if saving fails to improve recovery after short Sessions are interrupted. by @LogosVeritas - Expand leading ~ or ~/ in local file tools to the Host home directory while preserving literal tildes elsewhere in paths. by @turtle2099 - Preselect every recommended option in multiple-choice questions instead of only the first, while preserving single-choice and answered-card behavior. by @yudshj - Resolve relative chat file links from the Session working directory at click time so worktree Sessions do not open the original checkout. by @turtle2099 - Keep single tildes literal in Markdown and require double tildes for strikethrough. by @turtle2099 - Fix multiline $$ math rendering so opening-line math and following prose are preserved. by @Chinesezjc - Show the current local Markdown image in newly rendered messages and previews after the file is overwritten. by @turtle2099 - Fix bare URLs incorrectly including following Chinese punctuation and text in links. by @turtle2099 - Preserve backslash separators in Windows-path Markdown links and images so they resolve to the intended location. by @turtle2099 - Include whole-turn deliveries and writes in deliverable cards and closing-reply file links, even after the reply; present guidance tells agents to link files before waiting for user input. by @yudshj - Fix prolonged page freezes caused by syntax highlighting of certain struct definitions. by @yudshj - Fix pasted file and folder paths being highlighted only through their directory prefixes in the composer. by @turtle2099 - Pause the chat running clock during disconnection or reconnection and resume elapsed-time display after reconnecting. by @turtle2099 - Keep retained steering and follow-up input in log order before assistant output in Trajectory, including after refresh and history loading. by @kermanx - Use isolated, theme-backed sidebar drag previews to avoid capturing content behind rows while preserving native reordering. by @Stevring - Make settings-navigation hover visible in dark mode while retaining selected-state priority. by @turtle2099 - Expand and collapse long questions and option descriptions in place, with navigation and submission controls kept visible. by @yudshj - Prevent a window-activating click on a Session title from accidentally opening rename on macOS, while preserving normal double-click rename. by @turtle2099 - Preserve the sidebar file-tab strip's scroll position when selecting, opening, or closing tabs instead of restarting from the left edge. by @turtle2099 - Run ordinary conversation forks independently instead of treating them as subagents, while preserving creator relationships for real subagents. by @Dudu-0223 - Use SSH for self-hosted Git plugin installation when HTTPS is unreadable and SSH is available. by @turtle2099 - Offer script approval and retry when installing Git plugins with prepare scripts instead of reporting only an unknown error. by @turtle2099 - Approval messages explicitly state whether user approval is requested, avoiding ambiguity around the never policy. by @turtle2099 - Prevent history expansion from rewriting exclamation marks or causing persistent Bash command timeouts on macOS. by @grllll - Tell the model to continue after a skipped question without asking it again or treating the skip as permission. by @turtle2099 - Keep skills from healthy roots available when another skill root cannot be read, and report incomplete discovery. by @Dudu-0223 - Resolve configuration-project plugins using the project’s ESM rules for dependency subpaths, package imports, and self-references. by @shigma - Allow Web Fetch to read valid UTF-8 pages whose encoding declarations contain multiple labels including UTF-8. by @Dudu-0223 - Fix tool calls failing on unambiguous optional arguments by accepting an empty grep include. by @turtle1999 - Fix restricted sandbox commands failing to start when DSH runs as administrator or in Windows Sandbox, while preserving file-write and deletion restrictions. by @huoyaoyuan - Correct the Windows installed-app publisher and keep the application name separate from its version in uninstall listings. by @winewill - Improve Windows installer progress rendering, dragging, and activation, restore native minimize transitions, and trigger caption buttons on release inside the original button. by @winewill - Exit the Desktop Host immediately after acknowledging completed teardown so leftover event-loop handles do not block update installation. by @turtle2099 - Leave macOS fullscreen before Desktop update confirmation so failed installs recover the workspace; preserve tasks and show retry guidance if fullscreen exit times out. by @winewill - Show desktop update prompts in-window without raising native child windows for background results, and match prompts to the app’s light or dark theme. by @winewill - Keep conversation header menus close to their trigger buttons on macOS desktop. by @turtle2099 - Fix the native macOS directory picker initially appearing inactive and ignoring directory clicks. by @EricMoin ### Chores - Raise the minimum supported Node.js version to 24.9. Upgrade older Node.js runtimes before upgrading DSH. by @tianyicui - Provide SDK file delivery, questions, scheduling, skills, and context capabilities consistent with Web mode, with question callbacks and operation approval. by @koalazf99 - Fix event publication and cleanup around Session creation, recovery, and disposal. Make initialization events available to live subscribers and wait for acquired resources to finish cleanup on cancellation. by @kermanx - Add independent Session APIs to read snapshots and continuously subscribe to Session event logs, execution state, and event-projection data. by @imccyu - Migrate custom plugins to asynchronous retained Session-projection handles. Legacy registration disposers and key-based reads retain compatibility with deprecation notices; approval-state recovery requires the composition to provide sessionProjections and await service activation. by @kermanx, @Magolor - Allow whole-unit JSON and SQLite storage to read explicitly declared compatible older versions and write in the current version format. by @Magolor - Allow Web Fetch to access non-public addresses for proxies and internal networks; deployments must restrict network access separately. by @turtle2099 - Synchronize Cordis Timer with its upstream implementation; custom plugins must adapt to changed return values. by @shigma - Provide unified Cordis Fiber access to raw configuration, candidate resolution, and effective configuration, used consistently by settings and hot reload. by @shigma - Retrieve diagnostic reports for desktop startup failures, including a bounded history of recent plugin operations to help troubleshooting. by @winewill - Add system and application permission onboarding to macOS Computer Use, support long clicks, and improve application launching. Retain application permissions across restarts. by @CreatixChu, @koalazf99 - Support experimental Auto review in Headless. by @tianyicui - Keep Ralph loop and Session search bundled, but no longer list them among experimental plugins. by @ZiyaZhang - Upgrade pi-ai to 1.3.0 with updated model catalogs, endpoints, and reasoning replay rules; malformed completed tool arguments fail the response before any tool executes. by @tianyicui - Default undeclared custom-model capacities to decimal 1M context and 128K output; smaller endpoints should set explicit capacities to avoid delayed compaction. by @LegGasai - Capture the step model before prompt assembly and pre-step and retain it through retries; plugins should select through agent.model rather than changing routes in agent/request. by @kermanx - Rename Custom plugin markets to Custom plugin indexes. Discover reads user-added index files, and index generation excludes private versions, tags, and default-branch packages. by @turtle2099, @turtle1999 - Official bundle lists are now exported by @deepseek-ai/dsh-official-bundles; custom integrations must update imports from app-boot. by @turtle2099 - Activate tools conditionally per step with consistent model declarations, PTC bindings, and execution admission. Plugins must migrate tools.resolve/executable and prompt-assembly integration. by @LegGasai - Add a VM Script mode to Node PTC with top-level await, dynamic imports, and expression results, plus optional state retention across calls. Per-call execution remains the default; top-level return and using are unsupported. by @kermanx - Split native and PTC tool execution into Agent-scoped plugins; enable PTC through configuration overlays and migrate tools.mode and DSH_TOOLS_MODE usage. by @kermanx - Move the PTC Node control channel to birpc; upgrade self-deployed bootstraps and SSH helpers together, with SSH protocol increasing from 2 to 3. by @kermanx - Report caller-cancelled run_code calls in PTC Mode as ABORTED rather than CODE_RUN_FAILED. SDK and Session consumers must update cancellation handling. by @kermanx Full Changelog: [dsh-v0.2.1-rc.4...dsh-v0.2.2-alpha.2](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/compare/dsh-v0.2.1-rc.4...dsh-v0.2.2-alpha.2)

name: v1.0.0-preview.30
body:
Opt-in v1 preview built from master commit bd2ac1a8edcd9811ffd0f6ecf18f695adbc9744a.

Experimental binaries, not a stable release. Windows preview binaries are unsigned. Use the stable channel for production. Preview numbers may have gaps.

## First-time preview setup

Existing stable versions do not support `--channel`. Download the archive for your OS and architecture from this release, verify it against `SHA256SUMS`, and extract the entire archive into its own directory (keep all Linux companion files together). Run the extracted binary explicitly, using its full path, rather than the old stable `jcode` on PATH. For Windows, use the extracted `.exe`.

From that preview binary, run `jcode update --channel preview` (substitute its full path for `jcode`) to persist the opt-in channel and receive future previews. To roll back, run the preview binary with `update --channel stable`, or reinstall the current stable release. Stable users are never moved to previews automatically.

This preview series ends when the `v1.0.0` stable tag is created.

## First-time preview setup

Existing stable versions do not support `--channel`. Download the archive for your OS and architecture from this release, verify it against `SHA256SUMS`, and extract the entire archive into its own directory (keep all Linux companion files together). Run the extracted binary explicitly, using its full path, rather than the old stable `jcode` on PATH. For Windows, use the extracted `.exe`.

From that preview binary, run `jcode update --channel preview` (substitute its full path for `jcode`) to persist the opt-in channel and receive future previews. To roll back, run the preview binary with `update --channel stable`, or reinstall the current stable release. Stable users are never moved to previews automatically.

This preview series ends when the `v1.0.0` stable tag is created.

name: supervision-0.31.3
body:
# v0.31.3 — Grayscale annotators, OpenCV-exact fallbacks, and merged YOLO polygons

Grayscale scenes work with more annotators, the pure NumPy fallback matches OpenCV pixel for pixel, and YOLO export handles multi-part masks.

- **YOLO export** merges multi-part masks into one polygon and skips crowd annotations, with flags for the old output.
- Background overlay and comparison annotators draw on grayscale scenes.
- Without OpenCV, resize, blur, blending, drawing and connected components give the same pixels as OpenCV.
- Invalid input fails early: `ImageSink`, the video frame generator and depth arrays now raise clear errors.
- Short hex colors such as `"#f0f"` work in annotators.

Drop-in upgrade unless you export YOLO labels: the default output changes, see the Migration guide.

## ✨ Spotlights / highlights

### YOLO export merges multi-part masks and skips crowd annotations

`DetectionDataset.as_yolo` now omits detections whose `iscrowd` flag is set and writes a mask with several disconnected parts as one merged polygon line instead of one line per part. Both are on by default. The merge is done by the new `sv.merge_multi_segment`, which joins the parts through zero-width seams at their nearest vertices. (#2786)

```python
import supervision as sv

dataset = sv.DetectionDataset(...)
dataset.as_yolo(
    images_directory_path="images",
    annotations_directory_path="labels",
    data_yaml_path="data.yaml",
)  # 0.31.3: crowd skipped, one merged polygon line per mask

dataset.as_yolo(
    images_directory_path="images",
    annotations_directory_path="labels",
    data_yaml_path="data.yaml",
    ignore_crowd=False,
    merge_segments=False,
)  # the 0.31.2 output
```

### `sv.merge_multi_segment`

New public function. Pass it the polygon parts of one mask and get back a single polygon. (#2786)

```python
import numpy as np
import supervision as sv

a = np.array([[0, 0], [10, 0], [10, 10], [0, 10]])
b = np.array([[30, 30], [40, 30], [40, 40], [30, 40]])
sv.merge_multi_segment([a, b]).shape
# (10, 2)
```

### Annotators on grayscale scenes

`BackgroundOverlayAnnotator` and `ComparisonAnnotator` now draw on scenes shaped `(H, W)` or `(H, W, 1)`, or given as a Pillow `"L"` image, instead of raising `ValueError`. Short hex colors such as `"#f0f"` now work in annotators and `sv.hex_to_rgba`. (#2832, #2803, #2801)

```python
import numpy as np
import supervision as sv

scene = np.zeros((100, 100), dtype=np.uint8)
detections = sv.Detections(
    xyxy=np.array([[20, 20, 60, 60]], dtype=float), class_id=np.array([0])
)
sv.BackgroundOverlayAnnotator().annotate(scene.copy(), detections).shape
# (100, 100)  (0.31.2: ValueError)
```

### The NumPy fallback matches OpenCV pixel for pixel

Without OpenCV installed, `resize` (`INTER_LINEAR` on `uint8`), `blur`, `addWeighted`, thin lines, circles, filled polygons that leave the canvas, `connectedComponents` and `mean` now give the same pixels as OpenCV. `BlurAnnotator`, `HaloAnnotator`, `HeatMapAnnotator`, `PixelateAnnotator`, the blending annotators, `sv.resize_image`, `sv.letterbox_image` and `PolygonZone` masks are affected. (#2833, #2836, #2811, #2808, #2810, #2812, #2820)

### Bad input fails early

`sv.ImageSink(overwrite=False)` raises `FileExistsError` instead of replacing an existing image, `sv.get_video_frames_generator` rejects a stride below 1, and `DepthMap.from_ultralytics` rejects unwrapped integer arrays. (#2800, #2819, #2795)

```python
import supervision as sv

for frame in sv.get_video_frames_generator("video.mp4", stride=0):
    ...
# ValueError: stride must be >= 1, got 0
```

## 🔄 Migration guide

One default behavior changes: YOLO export. No public symbol was removed or renamed in this release, and nothing is deprecated.

**YOLO export defaults** affect `sv.DetectionDataset.as_yolo`, and `save_yolo_annotations` and `detections_to_yolo_annotations` in `supervision.dataset.formats.yolo`. Before 0.31.3 export skipped nothing and wrote a mask with several disconnected parts as one polygon line per part. From 0.31.3 export drops detections whose `iscrowd` flag is set in `detections.data`, and writes the parts of a mask as one merged polygon line. Label files exported with 0.31.3 can therefore differ from those exported with 0.31.2 for the same dataset. (#2786)

- Nothing to do if you want crowd annotations dropped and one polygon line per mask.
- To keep the 0.31.2 output, pass `ignore_crowd=False` and `merge_segments=False` to `as_yolo`.
- Re-export datasets you trained on from 0.31.2 labels only if the crowd or multi-part masks matter to your training run.

Three bug fixes also turn silent behavior into an error: `ImageSink(overwrite=False)` raises `FileExistsError` for an existing image (#2800), `get_video_frames_generator` raises `ValueError` for a stride below 1 (#2819), and `DepthMap.from_ultralytics` rejects unwrapped integer arrays (#2795).

## 📝 Notable changes

### 🚀 Added

- **`sv.merge_multi_segment`** — joins the disconnected polygon segments of one mask into a single polygon. (#2786)
- **`ignore_crowd` and `merge_segments`** — new parameters on `DetectionDataset.as_yolo`, `save_yolo_annotations` and `detections_to_yolo_annotations`. (#2786)
- **Depth showcase example** — `examples/depth_showcase` runs Depth Anything V2 Large, Apple Depth Pro and a YOLO depth model through `sv.DepthAnnotator` on video files, webcams and streams. (#2804, #2818)

### 🌱 Changed

- `DetectionDataset.as_yolo` now skips crowd annotations and writes multi-part masks as one merged polygon line. Pass `ignore_crowd=False` and `merge_segments=False` for the previous output. (#2786)

### 🔧 Fixed

**Annotators**

- `BackgroundOverlayAnnotator` and `ComparisonAnnotator` raised `ValueError` on grayscale scenes. (#2832, #2803)
- Annotators and `sv.hex_to_rgba` rejected 3- and 4-digit short hex colors such as `"#f0f"`. (#2801)

**Input validation, I/O and metrics**

- `ImageSink(overwrite=False)` silently replaced an existing image, including through a dangling symlink; it now raises `FileExistsError`, and a path with an embedded null character raises `ValueError`. (#2800)
- `get_video_frames_generator` could yield frames past `end` for `stride=0` or a negative stride; it now raises `ValueError`. (#2819)
- `DepthMap.from_ultralytics` accepted unwrapped integer arrays as depth values. (#2795)
- `KeyPoints.as_detections` and `with_nms` let an extra coordinate change the boxes; they now use x/y only. (#2817)
- `MeanAverageRecall.compute()` raised `IndexError` when filtering by object size with shared scalar metadata. (#2791)
- `download_assets(VideoAssets.GROCERY_STORE)` failed MD5 verification; the catalog now holds the checksum of the hosted file. (#2804)

**NumPy fallback without OpenCV**

- `resize` with `INTER_LINEAR` on `uint8` images now matches OpenCV pixel for pixel; arm64 builds that hand some grayscale and RGBA resizes to the Carotene HAL can differ by up to two levels. (#2833)
- `addWeighted` rounds 8-bit, 16-bit and float32 blends like OpenCV. (#2836)
- `blur` rounds 8-bit results like OpenCV. (#2811)
- `line`, `polylines`, `drawContours` and `circle` at thickness 1, and filled circles, match OpenCV; a negative circle radius raises `ValueError`. (#2808)
- `fillPoly` and filled `drawContours` match OpenCV for polygons that leave the canvas. (#2810)
- `connectedComponents` and `connectedComponentsWithStats` number 8-connected components in OpenCV's order. (#2812)
- `mean` keeps small values when large positive and negative `float32` pixels cancel. (#2820)

## 🏆 Contributors

Welcome to our first-time contributors: Oke Iyanuoluwa Enoch, Maidul Hasan Masum, Jooyoung Lim, Zhenhuan Wang, Shreya Boyane, Carlos Marañes, Vuln3rat0r and reuben rouse!

- **Oke Iyanuoluwa Enoch** (@Iyanuoluwa007, [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/iyanuoluwa-enoch-oke/)) — made the NumPy fallback match OpenCV for thin lines, circles, polygons, blur and connected components, and added strict type checking across the tests.
- **LEE, WEI-HONG** (@AuricTW) — made `ImageSink` refuse to overwrite existing images, rejected non-positive frame strides, and kept `float32` precision in the mean fallback.
- **kevin** (@kevin9327) — made the NumPy fallback `resize` and `addWeighted` match OpenCV.
- **A Aswanth Raj** (@aswanth-07, [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/a-aswanth-raj/)) — built key point boxes from x/y coordinates and kept scalar metadata in recall size buckets.
- **Vuln3rat0r** (@Vuln3rat0r) — added `sv.merge_multi_segment` and merged multi-part masks in YOLO export.
- **Mohammad Hijjawi** (@MohammadHijjawi97, [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mohammadhijjawi)) — made `BackgroundOverlayAnnotator` work on grayscale scenes.
- **Shreya Boyane** (@Sonica-B, [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/shreya-boyane/)) — made `ComparisonAnnotator` work on grayscale scenes.
- **Carlos Marañes** (@cmaranes) — accepted short hex colors in annotators.

Stable releases remain on the `latest` dist-tag.

## What's Changed

name: graphify 0.9.97
body:
## 0.9.97 (2026-10-27)

- Security: **rationale redaction** credential redaction for rationale labels moves to a single pre-cache choke point (`_redact_rationale_labels` inside `_safe_extract`), so no extractor can skip it, and it now covers more leak shapes: URL userinfo with an empty user or with `/`/`@` in the password, PEM private-key bodies, tokens glued to surrounding text by `_` (for example `ghp_...`), Slack `xoxe-` refresh tokens, short JWTs, and Common Lisp docstrings that previously built labels without redacting. Benign strings (hashes, `sk-` prose, URLs without userinfo) are left alone (#4647, thanks @0xkaushik-ai).
- Security: **deps** anyio is floored to `>=4.14.2` in the `mcp` extra, above CVE-2026-63374 (an IDNA 2003 vs 2008 hostname-validation bypass that let a MITM on a non-ASCII domain present a cert for a different ASCII host, CVSS 9.3). anyio is only a transitive dependency and the lockfile already resolves 4.15.1, so this is a floor to stop a future re-resolution from regressing.
- Fix: **markdown** ATX headings parse per CommonMark: a trailing run of `#` is not part of the heading text (`## Setup ##` is "Setup"), up to three spaces of indent are allowed (four is an indented code block), and a hash-only line like `## ##` mints no node (#4790, #4791, thanks @jaimemartinez).
- Fix: **markdown** fenced code blocks are tracked by CommonMark rules (backtick and tilde fences, info strings, matching close length), so a line that looks like a heading inside a fence no longer leaks as structure, and a heading after a `~~~` block that contains a ` ``` ` line is no longer lost (#4787, #4788, thanks @jaimemartinez).
- Fix: **yaml** structural extraction reads the composed node tree, so keys carry their written spelling and their own source line instead of all landing on line 1, and YAML 1.1 bare keys like `on`/`off`/`yes`/`no` are no longer folded to booleans (a workflow `on:` block is extracted, not turned into a `True` node) (#4784, #4785, thanks @jaimemartinez).
- Fix: **razor** a component's `@implements` interfaces are extracted as `implements` edges instead of being silently dropped (#4820, thanks @ayushcodes10).
- Fix: **terraform** an aliased provider block gets its own alias-qualified node (so two `provider "aws"` blocks no longer collapse into one and lose attributes), and a `provider = aws.west` reference resolves to it instead of dangling; a `local` literally named `provider` is no longer misread (#4819, thanks @ayushcodes10).
- Fix: **cobol** paragraphs that follow a nested `END PROGRAM` reattach to the enclosing program instead of sticking to the nested one, via a program stack (#4824, thanks @ayushcodes10).
- Fix: **blade** a `wire:click` directive binds the bare method name: dotted modifiers (`wire:click.prevent="submit"`) are matched, call arguments are trimmed from the name (`deleteItem(5)` binds `deleteItem`), and a `$`-prefixed magic action mints no fabricated edge (#4823, thanks @ayushcodes10).
- Fix: **pascal** a `record` is recognised as a type with its own methods in the regex fallback (the default path without the optional `pascal` extra), matching the tree-sitter path; `operator` members are extracted too (#4825, thanks @ayushcodes10).
- Fix: **vbnet** an `Operator` declaration is extracted as an `operator`-kind member of its class and its body is walked for calls, so a helper call inside an operator no longer vanishes (#4821, thanks @ayushcodes10).
- Fix: **fortran** a `call` resolves to the subroutine it actually names instead of a target salted with the calling file's name (which never resolved), using the extractor's own cross-file stub idiom (#4795, thanks @ayushcodes10).
- Fix: **cli** `graphify query --help`/`-h` (and now `graphify explain --help`/`-h`) with nothing else prints usage instead of running a literal query for the text "--help"; a longer question that merely contains "--help" as a substring still runs as a query (#4830, thanks @curl-man).
- Fix: **js** a nested (inner) function no longer leaks into the file-wide name map, so a call elsewhere in the file binds to the top-level function of that name rather than an inner one it cannot see; recursion, shadowing and sibling scopes resolve correctly (ports the Python scope scheme to JS/TS) (#4767, thanks @smngvlkz).
- Fix: **ocaml** every binding in an `and`-chained `module ... and ...` or `class ... and ...` is extracted, not just the first, so later bindings are no longer silently dropped; each carries its own source line (#4822, thanks @ayushcodes10).
- Fix: **verilog** a SystemVerilog class `task` method is modeled like a `function` one (its own node, `method` edge and parameter-type references), and a task-local variable no longer leaks as a false field reference on the class (#4774, thanks @ayushcodes10).
- Fix: **build** an edge with no `relation` is dropped instead of persisted, on both the build and the raw `--no-cluster` write paths, and alias folding (`relationship` to `relation`) runs before the check (#4810, thanks @legendteddy; reproducer also filed as #4826 by @sunhouy).
- Fix: **build** the shrink guard counts a saved document-mention node that folds into its AST file twin on reload as present, not lost, so a cluster-only write is no longer refused when nothing was actually lost (#4778, #4779, thanks @AndresDiagoM).
- Fix: **detect** a linked git worktree whose main checkout resolves inside the scan root is pruned, so a sibling worktree no longer gets indexed as a second full copy of the repo (#4683, #4833, thanks @barlowa124; duplicate work in #4685 by @AndresDiagoM).
- Fix: **resolution** an inline comment in a pnpm-workspace glob is stripped per YAML rules, and a glob that `Path.glob` rejects (a `**` component or an absolute pattern) is skipped with a warning instead of crashing the whole `extract` run (#4681, #4687, thanks @Deepjyoti-Sarmah).
- Fix: **report** a community hub `[[wikilink]]` is slugged through the same `export._obsidian_safe_stem` the export uses, so the link matches the file the export actually writes instead of dangling (#4696, thanks @ayushcodes10).
- Fix: **wiki** a community relabelled only by letter case keeps its article instead of having the sweep delete the file the run just wrote; on a case-sensitive filesystem the stale lower-case twin is unlinked rather than renamed over the fresh file (which would silently restore the old body) (#4508, #4798, thanks @dupeisen).
- Fix: **query** filler verbs `get`/`gets`/`got`/`getting` are dropped from query terms (like the existing `work`/`works`), so a framework hub labelled "Get" is not pulled in as a BFS seed by an exact-match bonus; node lookups for a literal `Get` still resolve (#4686, thanks @AndresDiagoM).
